description: List the fastener families in the document catalogue: id, kind, standard, licence, grip mode, part-number pattern and every size dash with its diameter in inches. Use it to find the family id and diameterDash that select_fastener and insert_fastener_stack need. Returns data.families; the document is unchanged.

kind.description: Optional filter: only families of this kind (bolt, hi_lok_pin, solid_rivet, nut, washer, ...).

name: list_fastener_families

description: Read-only steel section catalogue: IPE, HEA, HEB, UPN, cold-formed C purlins, SHS, RHS, CHS and equal angles L, with depth h, width b, web / flange thickness (mm), mass (kg/m), area (mm²) and paint perimeter (mm). Optionally filter by family.
name: list_steel_profiles

description: Replace the current document with one parsed from a serialized JSON string produced by serializeDocument (envelope format: llull-document v3; v1 and v2 are still read). On parse or validation failure the document is left unchanged.

json.description: A JSON string produced by serializeDocument — the full llull-document envelope ({ format: "llull-document", version: 3, document: { ... } }; versions 1 and 2 are also read). Must contain a valid CadDocument with entities, order, layers, layerOrder, selection, and camera.

name: load_document

description: Loft a solid through 2+ cross-sections placed in 3D, in order: transitions such as round-to-square ducts, tapered and flattened bike tubes, bottle and nozzle bodies, boat hulls, aero fairings. Right-handed world frame, +Z up. Give either `sectionIds` (closed 2D sketches: circle, ellipse, rectangle, closed polyline or spline; each placed by its own work-plane position and rotation) or inline `sections` (each a center [x, y, z], optional plane rotation (Euler XYZ radians, [0,0,0] = an XY-plane section), and one of radius, radiusX+radiusY, section points or sectionId). Sections are resampled to the same point count and aligned so the surface does not twist; ruled: false (default) blends smoothly through all sections, ruled: true joins neighbours with straight lines. Kept exact for the OCC kernel and STEP export (B-spline skin through the sections).

color.description: Hex color string #rrggbb, e.g. "#c8553d". Defaults to "#6b8f9c".

id.description: Optional explicit entity id. If omitted a unique id is generated.

layerId.description: Layer id to assign the entity to. Defaults to the document default layer.

ruled.description: true: straight lines between neighbouring sections; false (default): smooth blend.

sectionIds.description: Ids of closed 2D sketches, in loft order, each in its own (parallel or tilted) plane.

sections.description: Inline sections in loft order (alternative to sectionIds).

center.description: Section plane origin [x, y, z] in world coordinates.

radiusX.description: Elliptical section: half-width along section x (> 0); give with radiusY.

radiusY.description: Elliptical section: half-height along section y (> 0); give with radiusX.

rotation.description: Section plane rotation, Euler XYZ radians; [0, 0, 0] lays the section in the XY plane.

sectionId.description: Id of a closed 2D sketch (circle, ellipse, rectangle, closed polyline/spline).

name: loft_sections

description: Record that a cloud arrived pre-registered (contractor data) without a llull registration: a record of method "supplied", status "unverified", so everything derived from the cloud carries unverified until a reviewer accepts it (accept_registration).

cloudId.description: Id of an attached cloud (affected[0] of attach_point_cloud, e.g. "cloud-1.1").

reportRef.description: Reference of the contractor registration report.

name: mark_registration_supplied

description: Measure the volume, area, centroid, inertia and (when a density is known) the mass of a 3D solid, in the document unit. Supported entity kinds: 'box', 'cylinder', 'sphere' (closed forms), 'extrusion', 'cone', 'torus', 'wedge', 'pyramid', 'revolution' (Pappus's centroid theorem; a profile crossing the axis falls back to the bounding-box volume), 'sweep' (round section: section area × exact path length), 'loft', 'subdivision', 'mesh' (a kernel result with the OCC kernel: the exact B-rep; otherwise its display triangles), and 'instance' (assembly: the combined mass, centroid and inertia of its component solids, each with its own material, else the instance material, else the density param). 2D shape entities are rejected. Density resolution, in order: the assigned material's density property model (define_property_model property "density"; the preferred one, read at 20 degC), else the material's plain density (create_material, g/(document-unit)³), else the density param. A material always wins over the param. With none, mass is not given and the inertia is per unit density. If a material has density models that cannot be used (several and none preferred, or not valid at 20 degC), the command refuses with that code instead of falling back. Method order: exact (OCC kernel B-rep integration) > closed-form (primitives; volume of cone, torus, revolution, ... with inertia from the triangles scaled to it) > mesh (display triangles, integrated in a part frame so a part far from the origin keeps its precision). Returns data: { volume, volumeUnit (e.g. "mm³"), method ("exact" | "closed-form" | "mesh"), centroid (document unit, in the chosen frame), area and areaUnit when known, frame, inertia: { atCentroid, atOrigin (about `about`, default the frame origin), about, principal: { moments (ascending), axes (unit vectors, right-handed) }, radiiOfGyration, unit ("g·mm²" with a density, else "mm⁵ (per unit density)") } (3x3 matrices, row-major, off-diagonals are -∫xy dm), provenance: { method, kernel: { name, ... }, inputs: { entityIds, recipeKey?, densitySource } }, reviewRequired: { value, reasons[] }, warnings? (KRN_PRECISION_ENVELOPE when the part is beyond ±1e5 mm), relErrorEstimate? } and, when a density is known, { density (g/(document-unit)³), densityKgPerM3, mass (in massUnit), massUnit, massG, massKg, massLb, densitySource (which value was used), densityDefaulted, unverified, unverifiedReasons } (plus unit: "g" when massUnit is g). A plain material density or a param is always unverified (no basis or source); a density model is unverified when its basis is typical / supplier_unstated / unspecified (unverified is about the density only). reviewRequired.value is true for purpose weight-and-balance, any unverified density, a mesh-integrated figure ('method_mesh'), a mesh body without a B-rep ('faceted_body'), or a part outside the precision envelope; the summary then says the figure is computed by llull, not approved, and needs a qualified engineer. Does not modify the document.

about.description: Optional point [x, y, z] in document length units, expressed in the chosen frame, about which data.inertia.atOrigin is taken (parallel-axis theorem). Default: the frame origin [0, 0, 0].

unit.description: Density unit, e.g. "g/cm^3", "kg/m^3", "lb/in^3".

density.description: Optional fallback density, used only for solids without an assigned material; omit it to measure the volume alone. Either { value, unit } (e.g. { "value": 0.101, "unit": "lb/in^3" }) or a bare number in g/(document-unit)³ (for a mm document: steel ≈ 0.00785, aluminium ≈ 0.0027). Must be > 0.

entityId.description: Id of the 3D solid entity to measure. Supported kinds: 'box', 'cylinder', 'sphere', 'extrusion', 'mesh', 'cone', 'torus', 'wedge', 'pyramid', 'revolution', 'sweep', 'loft', 'subdivision', 'instance'.

frame.description: Frame of data.centroid and data.inertia: 'document' (default; world axes, origin at the document origin) or 'entity' (axes and origin of the entity's own position / rotation).

massUnit.description: Unit of data.mass and of the summary: g (default), kg or lb. massG / massKg / massLb are always given.

purpose.description: 'general' (default) or 'weight-and-balance'. weight-and-balance marks the result reviewRequired (data.reviewRequired.value true): the figure is computed by llull and not approved; a qualified engineer must review it before it is used for flight or certification.

name: mass_properties

description: Drive one material point of a constitutive set along a path and return stress-strain history without a mesh. Each step imposes strain (dimensionless; engineering shear for xy, xz, yz) or stress ({ value, unit }) per component xx, yy, zz, xy, xz, yz, reached linearly over its increments; uncontrolled components stay stress-free. Presets fill components a step leaves out: uniaxial_strain, plane_strain (zz, xz, yz held at zero strain, NAFEMS NL1), equibiaxial (yy follows xx), pure_shear (yy held), simple_shear, uniaxial_stress. Give increments per step (default 100, named). Small strain for elasticity, J2 plasticity, Ramberg-Osgood, Prony viscoelasticity and creep; finite for incompressible hyperelastic modes (xx = nominal strain λ − 1 or nominal stress; rows carry Hencky strain, Cauchy stress, stretch and nominal stress). Stress in MPa, time in s, T in K; step and increment are 1-based; at most 100 000 increments per call.  Next: compare with test data, then check_material_models.

forCertification.description: Refuse a result built on unverified data (MAT_VALUE_UNVERIFIED) and flag reviewRequired.

kinematics.description: 'small' strain, or 'finite' for hyperelastic homogeneous modes.

model.description: Ad-hoc law in add_material_model input form, not stored; it fills the slot of its behaviour (alone when no set is given).

output.description: 'steps' (default): one row per step end; 'increments': every increment (at most 10 000 rows).

preset.description: State preset filling the components a step does not control.

set.description: Constitutive set id (default: the material default set).

strain.description: Strain target at the end of the step.

stress.description: Stress target at the end of the step.

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 'MPa', 's', 'K'.

control.description: Per component xx, yy, zz, xy, xz, yz: exactly one of strain or stress. Absolute targets at the end of the step.

duration.description: Step duration (default 1 s; read by rate, time and creep laws).

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 'MPa', 's', 'K'.

temperature.description: Temperature of the step; referenced property models are evaluated there.

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 'MPa', 's', 'K'.

name: material_point_response

description: Draw the flat pattern of a sheet-metal part as plain 2D entities (outline polyline, cutouts, bend lines) on layers FLAT-<id>, FLAT-<id>-CUT, FLAT-<id>-BEND-UP and FLAT-<id>-BEND-DOWN, so it can be seen (render_view view=top) and drafted on. It is a snapshot: re-running replaces the previous snapshot of the same part. Lengths are in the document length unit. Refusal: FTR_PART_NOT_FOUND, FTR_NON_DEVELOPABLE. Use flat_pattern for the numbers and export_flat_pattern_dxf for the file.

id.description: Sheet-metal part id (returned by add_sheet_metal_base).

origin.description: Optional plane position [x, y] in the document length unit where the lower-left corner of the pattern is placed. Default: beside the folded part, right of its bounding box.

name: materialize_flat_pattern

description: Measure an angle. Provide either: (a) three world-space points as [[vx,vy,vz],[a1x,a1y,a1z],[a2x,a2y,a2z]] where the first point is the vertex and the angle is between the two rays vertex→arm1 and vertex→arm2; or (b) two line entity ids (lineId1, lineId2) to measure the angle between their direction vectors. Returns data: { degrees, radians }. Does not modify the document.

lineId1.description: Id of the first 'line' entity. Used together with lineId2 to measure the angle between two lines.

points.description: Three world-space points [[vx,vy,vz],[a1x,a1y,a1z],[a2x,a2y,a2z]]. First is the vertex; angle is measured between rays vertex→point[1] and vertex→point[2].

name: measure_angle

description: Compute the area of a closed 2D shape. Provide either: (a) an entityId for a closed polyline, rectangle, circle, or ellipse entity; or (b) an explicit polygon as points ([[x,y],...], >= 3 points). Returns data: { area, unit } where unit is the squared document unit (e.g. "mm²"). Open polylines are rejected with an explanatory message. Does not modify the document.

entityId.description: Id of a closed 2D shape entity: 'polyline' (must have closed:true), 'rectangle', 'circle', or 'ellipse'.

points.description: Explicit polygon vertices [[x,y],...] in the local 2D plane. Must have at least 3 points. The polygon is implicitly closed (last → first).

name: measure_area

description: Compute the world-space axis-aligned bounding box (AABB). Three modes: (a) entityId — AABB of one entity; (b) useSelection:true — combined AABB of the current document selection; (c) no params (or useSelection:false) — combined AABB of the entire document. Returns data: { min:[x,y,z], max:[x,y,z], size:[w,h,d] }. Does not modify the document. Entity rotation and the sweep angle of a partly turned profile are applied (the AABB wraps the actual geometry).

entityId.description: Id of the entity whose bounding box to compute. Takes precedence over useSelection.

useSelection.description: When true and entityId is not provided, compute the AABB of the current selection. Falls back to the whole document if the selection is empty.

name: measure_bounding_box

description: Read-only point-to-point measure on a cloud: each end is a point or {nearest: point} snapped to the closest scan point within snapRadius. Returns the distance, the delta [dx, dy, dz] and the snapped points (document units).

cloudId.description: Id of an attached cloud (affected[0] of attach_point_cloud, e.g. "cloud-1.1").

nearest.description: [x, y, z] seed: snaps to the nearest scan point within snapRadius.

from.description: A point [x, y, z] or {nearest: [x, y, z]} snapped to the cloud (document units).

snapRadius.description: Snap radius for {nearest} ends in document units (default 50 mm).

nearest.description: [x, y, z] seed: snaps to the nearest scan point within snapRadius.

to.description: A point [x, y, z] or {nearest: [x, y, z]} snapped to the cloud (document units).

name: measure_cloud

description: Measure the straight-line distance between two locations. Each location may be a world-space point [x,y,z] (point1/point2) or an entity id (entityId1/entityId2, centroid used). Mix point and entity freely (e.g. point1 + entityId2). Returns data: { distance, unit } and a factual summary. Does not modify the document.

entityId1.description: Id of the first entity. Its bounding-box centroid is used as the first location when point1 is not provided.

entityId2.description: Id of the second entity. Its bounding-box centroid is used as the second location when point2 is not provided.

point1.description: First world-space point [x, y, z]. Omit to use entityId1 centroid instead.

point2.description: Second world-space point [x, y, z]. Omit to use entityId2 centroid instead.

name: measure_distance

description: Compute the perimeter or total length of a 2D shape. Supported entity kinds: 'line' (segment length), 'polyline' (sum of segment lengths; closed polyline adds last→first segment), 'rectangle' (2*(width+height)), 'circle' (circumference 2πr), 'arc' (arc length r*|angle|). Returns data: { perimeter, unit }. Does not modify the document.

entityId.description: Id of the 2D shape entity to measure. Supported kinds: 'line', 'polyline', 'rectangle', 'circle', 'arc'.

name: measure_perimeter

description: Mirror an entity across the origin along a world axis by negating that axis component of its position. axis must be 'x', 'y', or 'z'.

axis.description: World axis to mirror across: 'x' negates the X position component, 'y' negates Y, 'z' negates Z.

id.description: Id of the entity to mirror.

name: mirror_entity

description: Evaluate the mechanism across a value sweep and return per-step instance transforms plus interference flags. mode="joint": sweep a single joint (by jointId) through a value range (radians for revolute, units for prismatic). mode="parameter": sweep a named doc.parameters entry through a value range, propagating to any joints that reference it. "target" is the joint id or parameter name to sweep. "start" and "end" define the sweep range (inclusive). "steps" is the number of samples (default 24; clamped to [2, 360]; non-integers rounded). "interferenceCheck" (default false): when true, runs a lightweight overlap test (axis-aligned box of each instance in its rotated pose; faces that merely touch are not interference) on every instance pair at each step. Returns the input document unchanged (affected:[]) with data: { steps: MotionStep[], interferences: InterferencePair[],   summary: { totalSteps: number, framesWithInterference: number } }. Failure cases (unknown target, start===end, steps<2) return an explanatory summary with empty data.

end.description: End value of the sweep range (inclusive). For revolute joints: radians. For prismatic joints: document units. For parameters: the parameter's unit.

interferenceCheck.description: When true, run a lightweight AABB overlap pass on every pair of InstanceEntity objects at each step. Colliding pairs are recorded in the returned interferences array. Default: false.

mode.description: Sweep mode. "joint": vary a specific joint value directly. "parameter": vary a named doc.parameters entry; downstream joints that reference it are re-evaluated.

start.description: Start value of the sweep range (inclusive). For revolute joints: radians. For prismatic joints: document units. For parameters: the parameter's unit.

steps.description: Number of samples across the range (default 24, minimum 2, maximum 360). Must be an integer. Step k = start + (end - start) * k / (steps - 1).

target.description: What to sweep. For mode="joint": the joint id (must exist in doc.joints). For mode="parameter": the parameter name (must exist in doc.parameters and resolve to a number).

name: motion_study

description: Move building elements in plan by delta [dx, dy]. Doors/windows travel with their wall (to slide an opening along its wall use update_opening). Corner joins are recomputed. A moved pipe takes its pipe supports along and a moved steel member makes its supports re-check their reach: they re-attach to the steel at the new position or become unattached (the summary says which).
name: move_building_element

description: Translate several entities by the same delta in one step (one undo). Ids that do not exist are skipped and listed in the summary; if none exist nothing changes.

delta.description: Translation [dx, dy, dz] in document units applied to every entity.

ids.description: Entity ids to move (non-empty, at most 10000). Missing ids are skipped.

name: move_entities

description: Read-only snap to a scan point: the cloud point nearest to `point` (document units) within maxDistance, with its source record index and the distance of the second-nearest point (ambiguity check: when both are close, pick a better seed). data.found is false when no point is within maxDistance.

cloudId.description: Id of an attached cloud (affected[0] of attach_point_cloud, e.g. "cloud-1.1").

name: nearest_cloud_point

description: Read-only ideal rocket engine (thrust chamber + nozzle) performance by 1D isentropic flow of a perfect gas (Sutton & Biblarz ch. 3, NASA SP-125): characteristic velocity c*, exit Mach / pressure / temperature / velocity, thrust coefficient C_F and specific impulse Isp in vacuum and at the ambient pressure, mass flow and thrust. Chamber: `chamberPressure` (+ required `pressureUnit`), `chamberTemperatureK`, `gamma` and `molarMass` (kg/kmol) of the combustion gas — take the chamber values of a NASA CEA run, e.g. LOX/LH2 MR 6 at 206 bar: Tc 3599 K, γ 1.1475, M 13.61 (c* then matches CEA to 0.1 %, Isp the shifting-equilibrium value to ~3 %). Nozzle: `expansionRatio` Ae/At or `exitPressure`; `divergence` ideal (λ 1, default), conical (`halfAngleDeg`, λ = (1+cos α)/2) or factor (`divergenceFactor`, e.g. 0.99 for an 80 % bell). Ambient: `ambientPressure` or `altitudeM` (standard atmosphere); default vacuum. Size by `throatDiameterM`, `throatAreaM2` or a `thrustN` target (in vacuum or at ambient, `thrustAt`). `cStarEfficiency` (default 1) models combustion losses. Warns on over-expansion and on likely flow separation (p_e < 0.4 p_a, Summerfield). Next: design_nozzle for the CAD contour.

altitudeM.description: Ambient pressure of the U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 at this geometric altitude in m (-5000..86000).

ambientPressure.description: Ambient pressure in pressureUnit, >= 0 (0 = vacuum). Or altitudeM.

divergence.description: Exit-flow divergence loss: ideal (default, λ 1), conical (halfAngleDeg) or factor.

exitPressure.description: Design exit pressure in pressureUnit (0 < p_e < p_c). Give this or expansionRatio.

expansionRatio.description: Nozzle area ratio Ae/At > 1. Give this or exitPressure.

gamma.description: Ratio of specific heats of the gas, 1 < γ < 2 (≈ 1.13-1.25 for combustion products).

halfAngleDeg.description: conical: nozzle half-angle in degrees, 0 < α < 45 (15 typical).

molarMass.description: Molar mass of the gas in kg/kmol (g/mol), > 0.

pressureUnit.description: Unit of every pressure parameter: Pa, kPa, MPa, bar, atm (101325 Pa) or psi (6894.757 Pa). Required.

throatDiameterM.description: Throat diameter in m, > 0 (sizing; give at most one of the three sizing inputs).

thrustAt.description: Condition of thrustN: vacuum (default) or ambient.

thrustN.description: Target thrust in N, > 0: the throat is sized for it.

name: nozzle_performance

description: Create a parallel-offset copy of a 2D shape at the given distance. Supported kinds: line (offset perpendicular to direction, positive=left of start→end), polyline (each segment offset then joined at miter intersections), circle (concentric: positive=larger, negative=smaller), rectangle (all sides expand/shrink: positive=outward, negative=inward). The original entity is unchanged; a new entity is added. No-op for unsupported kinds or if the resulting shape would be degenerate (e.g. negative circle radius).

distance.description: Offset distance in work-plane units. Positive = left of direction (line/polyline) or outward (circle/rectangle). Negative reverses the direction.

id.description: Id of the source entity to offset.

name: offset_2d

description: Lay copies of an entity along a curve: chain links round a chainring and cassette loop, tyre tread blocks round a tyre, sprocket / gear teeth, cable clips, rivets, fence posts, parts fanned on an arc. By default each copy is ORIENTED by the curve: model the source at the world origin in its "along the path" pose: its local +X follows the path tangent, +Y the path normal, +Z the binormal (≈ world up on a horizontal path); copies rotate about their position. orient:false keeps the source rotation instead (plain spacing along a path). rollStep adds an extra roll about the tangent per copy (π/2 alternates chain plates). Source: `sourceId` (an entity to copy) or `componentId` (fresh instances of a component from create_component). Path, give exactly one: `pathId` (a 2D sketch curve: line, arc, polyline, spline, circle, ellipse, rectangle; open or closed), `path` points (straight runs, or smooth: true for a spline; closed: true loops back) or `arc` (centre, normal, radius and angle sweep in radians; a full 2π sweep is a closed loop). Open paths put copies at both ends (a single copy sits at the start); closed loops space count copies evenly all round. startOffset / endOffset trim the open path from both ends (on a closed loop startOffset shifts the pattern). The source entity is kept.

arc.description: Alternative to pathId / path: a circular arc to follow.

center.description: World-space [x, y, z] centre of the arc.

endAngle.description: Sweep end in radians (counter-clockwise about normal).

normal.description: Normal of the arc plane (non-zero), e.g. [0, 0, 1] for an XY arc.

startAngle.description: Sweep start in radians from the plane's local +X axis.

closed.description: With path points: loop back from the last point to the first.

componentId.description: Alternative to sourceId: id of a component; each copy is a new instance of it.

endOffset.description: Path length skipped at the end (default 0, >= 0). Ignored on closed loops.

orient.description: Rotate each copy to the path frame (default true); false keeps the source rotation.

path.description: World [x, y, z] points of the path (>= 2). Alternative to pathId.

pathId.description: Id of a 2D sketch curve to follow (placed by its own work plane).

rollStep.description: Extra roll about the tangent added per copy, in radians (default 0).

smooth.description: With path points: a smooth spline through them (default: straight runs).

sourceId.description: Id of the entity to copy (2D or 3D).

startOffset.description: Path length skipped at the start (default 0, >= 0). On a closed loop: pattern shift.

name: pattern_along_path

description: Read-only pressure drop of one pipe run (add_pipe_run), flowing from its first to its last point. Give the run id (`pipeId`, e.g. "pipe-1") and exactly one flow: `flowM3h` (m³/h) or `massFlowKgS` (kg/s). Fluid is water at `temperatureC` (default 20 °C; density and viscosity from Kell / Vogel fits) unless `density` (kg/m³) and `viscosity` (Pa·s) are given for another liquid. Inner diameter = outside diameter minus twice the standard wall (Sch 40 / STD table of add_pipe_run, e.g. DN100 -> 102.26 mm). Roughness defaults by the pipe material (steel 0.045 mm, stainless 0.015, galvanised 0.15, cast iron 0.26, copper / plastic 0.0015). Friction: laminar 64/Re below Re 2300, else Colebrook-White solved iteratively. Straight loss = f (L/D) ρ v²/2 along the 3D centreline; fittings = ΣK ρ v²/2 with one K per interior bend from its deflection angle (K90 by `bendType`: long_radius 0.30, standard 0.40, mitre 1.10; K = K90 · sin(θ/2)/sin 45°) plus `extraK` (valves, entrance / exit); static = ρ g Δz (end minus start elevation, a riser adds head, a drop gives back). Returns data { diameter, velocity, reynolds, friction, losses (kPa), bends, pressureDrop { kPa, bar, headM }, warnings }; warns when velocity is outside 0.5-3 m/s (liquids) or the flow is laminar / transitional. Incompressible single-phase only (not for gas, steam or slurries).

bendType.description: Bend construction for K: long_radius (r/D 1.5, K90 0.30, default), standard (r/D 1, 0.40) or mitre (1.10).

density.description: Fluid density in kg/m³, > 0. Default: water at temperatureC.

extraK.description: Extra loss coefficient ΣK of valves, strainers, entrance / exit, ≥ 0. Default 0.

flowM3h.description: Volumetric flow in m³/h, > 0. Give this or massFlowKgS.

massFlowKgS.description: Mass flow in kg/s, > 0 (converted with the fluid density). Give this or flowM3h.

pipeId.description: Id of the pipe run from add_pipe_run, e.g. "pipe-1".

roughnessMm.description: Absolute pipe roughness ε in mm, > 0. Default by the pipe material (steel 0.045).

temperatureC.description: Water temperature in °C, 0..100. Default 20. Ignored for the property it overrides.

viscosity.description: Fluid dynamic viscosity in Pa·s (e.g. 0.001 for water), > 0. Default: water at temperatureC.

name: pipe_hydraulics

description: Earthworks report of a graded platform by the grid method: cut and fill volumes (m³), net (cut - fill, positive = surplus to export), cut / fill plan areas (m²), pad area, maximum cut / fill depth, grid spacing and the number of samples outside the TIN, plus the daylight line vertices. Read-only; data { platformId, cutM3, fillM3, netM3, cutAreaM2, fillAreaM2, padAreaM2, maxCutDepthM, maxFillDepthM, gridSpacingM, samples, samplesOutsideTin, daylight }.

gridSpacing.description: Grid cell size (document units). Default: about 2500 cells over the pad.

name: platform_earthworks

description: Run the physics simulation (same engine and parameters as simulate_motion) and draw the result as an SVG time-series chart, so a motion can be inspected without a screen. Returns data.svg (stacked panels sharing the time axis; each has a title, y axis with unit, grid, legend), data.width, data.panels (per series: min, max, final value, in the panel unit) and a one-line summary. `quantities` picks the panels: "joint_angle" (deg for revolute joints, mm for prismatic ones, from the start pose), "joint_velocity" (rpm / m/s), "motor_torque" (N·m), "motor_power" (kW), "reaction_force" (magnitude per tree joint and loop, N; runs the reaction pass, slower), "energy" (J: kinetic, potential = gravity + joint springs relative to the start pose, total, and cumulative energy dissipated by damping / friction: a flat total = conservation, a falling one = decay). `joints` restricts the series to those joint (or motor) ids. Default: joint_velocity of every joint. Closed loops and cylinders use the same timestep rules as simulate_motion. With the CLI, `llull plot_simulation … --save plot.png` rasterizes data.svg. Read-only; needs the physics engine like simulate_motion.

joints.description: Only these joint / motor ids (reaction_force: joint or loop ids). Default every one (at most 12 joint series).

quantities.description: Panels to draw: joint_angle, joint_velocity, motor_torque, motor_power, reaction_force, energy. Default ["joint_velocity"].

sampleRate.description: Samples per second drawn. Default about 600 points over the run (never below 50 Hz).

timestep.description: Integration step in seconds; default as simulate_motion.

name: plot_simulation

description: Read how result probes change over time: for every stored increment of a solved analysis (heat_transient: each written time; a static or steady case has one) return the probe value, so heating curves and settling can be checked without a screen. data { analysisId, series [{ probeId, name, quantity, unit, nodeId, nodeDistance, points [{ time (s), value }], missing (increments without a value), start, end, min, max (each { time, value } | null) }], svg (time-series chart, one panel per unit, or null when no probe has two increments), width, height }. The summary lists start / end / min / max per probe. Probes come from add_result_probe; values are read at the nearest mesh node, in the analysis unit system (temperature in the case scale). Needs state solved (fea_mesh then fea_solve); fea_report gives the same values inline per load case or time. With the CLI, `--save plot.png` rasterizes data.svg.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

plot.description: Draw data.svg. Default true; false returns the numbers only.

probeIds.description: Only these probe ids (affected[0] of add_result_probe). Default every probe of the analysis.

name: probe_history

description: Propagate the scatter of the random variables through the limit states. method "mc" (seeded Monte Carlo), "lhs" (Latin hypercube, default, lower variance) or "lhs_centred" sample `samples` points (default 10000, at most 2000000 in total over all limit states; needs an integer `seed` in [0, 4294967295]) and return for each limit state g: mean, sd, min, max, quantiles, a 20-bin histogram, Pf = P(g < 0) with standard error and Wilson 95 % interval, the equivalent beta, and PRB_PF_BELOW_RESOLUTION when nothing failed. method "fosm" (first-order second-moment, no seed) returns mean, sd, Cornell beta, Pf (g assumed normal) and the share of variance per variable. Correlation set with set_correlation is honoured. Limit states default to all defined ones. Computed by llull, not approved: a qualified engineer must review before any certification decision.

limitState.description: Only this limit state; default all limit states of the model.

samples.description: Number of samples (default 10000, at most 2000000). Ignored by fosm.

seed.description: Integer seed in [0, 4294967295] of the PRNG (xoshiro128**); the same model, method, samples and seed give bit-identical results.

name: propagate_uncertainty

description: Read-only bill of quantities of the building model, metric: wall length / net face area / volume, slab area / volume, column and beam volume, stair volume, door and window counts and areas, room floor area — grouped by category and material. Each line has a key like "wall.concrete.m3" used by estimate_cost. data.csv is spreadsheet-ready. Column and beam volumes are NET (measured once where members meet: slab > column > beam — columns run to the slab soffit, beams are measured below the slab soffit and between column faces; beam length stays centre-to-centre); data.gross maps the key of each line whose raw modelled volume differs to that gross quantity.
name: quantity_takeoff

description: Read-only: points of a cloud in a region, in document units and frame, as a flat [x, y, z, …] array in canonical order (deterministic). lod "full" (default) returns every point in the region up to maxPoints (≤ 200000); lod "budget" returns a level-of-detail subset of at most `budget` points (whole octree levels, coarse first). data.truncated says when maxPoints cut the answer (SCN_QUERY_LIMIT warning): narrow the region. indices are the source record numbers.

cloudId.description: Id of an attached cloud (affected[0] of attach_point_cloud, e.g. "cloud-1.1").

maxPoints.description: Hard cap on returned points (default 10000, at most 200000).

name: query_cloud_points

description: Recognise the manufacturing features of an exact 3D solid from its B-rep: holes (simple, counterbore, countersink, through or blind with a drill point; per hole the axis point at the entrance, the axis pointing into the material, diameter, countersink diameter / included angle in degrees / depth, counterbore diameter / depth, blind depth, drill point angle, face indices and confidence exact | ambiguous), pockets (floor height, depth, corner radius, floor fillet, open or closed), fillets, chamfers and sheet-metal bends. Faces of one surface that the kernel split in two (periodic cylinders and cones) are merged first. All lengths are in the document length unit, angles in degrees; results are deterministic and listed in data (counts, holes, pockets, bends, fillets, chamfers, unclassified face indices). Works on imported STEP solids (import_step_exact) and on parts built with add_hole / add_pocket. Needs an exact kernel: otherwise refused with FTR_NEEDS_EXACT_KERNEL (also FTR_PART_NOT_FOUND). Result computed by llull, not approved: reviewRequired is true.

angularTolerance.description: Angle tolerance in degrees for parallel axes and equal cone angles. Default 0.0001 degrees.

id.description: Id of the 3D solid (mesh with an exact B-rep) to analyse.

kinds.description: Feature kinds to report: hole, pocket, fillet, chamfer, bend. Omit for all.

lengthTolerance.description: Length tolerance in document length units for coaxial axes, equal radii and coplanar faces. Default 1e-6 of the model diagonal.

mergeSplitFaces.description: Merge faces on one analytic surface (split periodic faces) before recognising. Default true.

name: recognize_features

description: Record the summary of a finite-element mesh built by the host (fea_mesh transport) on an analysis. Not for hand use: the summary is re-derived from the stored mesh artifact and refused unless it matches exactly, so numbers cannot be invented. Clears recorded results. Refused with FEA_ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND when the artifact store does not hold the mesh, FEA_SUMMARY_MISMATCH when the summary differs, A mesh built for other inputs (the analysis or geometry changed since, e.g. on regeneration) is recorded STALE, not refused.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

summary.description: Exactly the summary returned by the host transport (never hand-written): it is recomputed from the artifact and compared.

meshHash.description: sha256 of the canonical mesh artifact JSON.

name: record_fe_mesh

description: Record the summary of solver results produced by the host (fea_solve transport) on an analysis that has a recorded mesh. Not for hand use: the summary is re-derived from the stored results artifact and refused unless it matches exactly. Refused with FEA_ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND (artifact absent), FEA_SUMMARY_MISMATCH, FEA_MESH_MISMATCH (results not computed on the recorded mesh, or no mesh recorded); results computed for other inputs are recorded STALE (re-run fea_mesh then fea_solve).

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

summary.description: Exactly the summary returned by the host transport (never hand-written): it is recomputed from the artifact and compared.

resultsHash.description: sha256 of the canonical results artifact JSON.

name: record_fea_results

description: Record the result of a topology optimization run by the host (topology_solve transport) on a study and derive its iso-surface solid. Not for hand use: the summary is re-derived from the stored density field artifact, so numbers cannot be invented. `summary` is optional; when given it must equal the recomputed one exactly (the transport passes it so a replay without the artifact store keeps the record as unverified, state missing). Refused with TOP_ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND (artifact absent), TOP_SUMMARY_MISMATCH (hash, field or summary differ), TOP_RESULT_STALE (the study, the analysis or the settings changed since the run: re-run topology_solve). The derived solid is a read-only concept shape on layer layer-topology; rebuild the part with suggest_rebuild and ordinary modelling commands.

fieldHash.description: sha256 of the canonical topology artifact JSON, as returned by the topology_solve transport.

studyId.description: Id of the topology study (affected[0] of create_topology_study, e.g. ts-3.1).

summary.description: Exactly the summary returned by the transport (never hand-written): it is recomputed from the artifact and compared.

name: record_topology_result

description: FORM reliability analysis of a limit state g(x) (failure when g < 0): Hasofer-Lind / Rackwitz-Fiessler iteration in standard normal space with a Nataf transform for the distributions and correlation. Returns data { beta, pfForm = Φ(-beta), designPointX { variable: { value, unit } } (most probable failure point), importance { variable: alpha^2 } (sums to 1: which variable drives failure), iterations, converged, items[] }. beta is negative when the origin (all variables at their medians) already fails. With sorm: true also the Breitung correction { curvatures, pfSorm, betaSorm } (needs a converged design point with beta > 0). Exact for linear g in normal variables (R - S: beta = (muR - muS) / sqrt(sR^2 + sS^2)). Gradients by central differences (step 1e-6 in u). Always flagged reviewRequired: Pf is not an approval. Computed by llull, not approved: a qualified engineer must review before any certification decision. Cross-check with run_reliability_study or propagate_uncertainty.

sorm.description: Also compute the SORM (Breitung) failure probability. Default false.

tolerance.description: FORM stops when no u component changes by more than this (default 1e-8).

name: reliability_form

description: Remove one decal (by its id, from add_decal) from a solid.

decalId.description: Id of the decal to remove.

id.description: Id of the solid carrying the decal.

name: remove_decal

description: Remove a declared interference intent (fit-<step>.<k>, from allow_interference). The pair is checked as an ordinary overlap again. Unknown id: no-op. Next: check_assembly.

id.description: Intent id returned by allow_interference, e.g. "fit-3.1".

name: remove_interference_intent

description: Remove an imported material library and its records from the document. Refused while an entity still uses one of its records (MAT_RECORD_IN_USE lists the entity ids): reassign them with assign_material first.

libraryId.description: Id of the imported library (get_material shows record.libraryRef).

name: remove_material_library

description: Remove one material model from a material. Refused while a constitutive set of the material lists it (MATL_MODEL_IN_USE).

id.description: Id of the model to remove.

name: remove_material_model

description: Remove one property model from a material. Refused while another model of the material is a ratioOf of it, or a material law reads it (PROP_MODEL_IN_USE).

modelId.description: Id of the model to remove.

name: remove_property_model

description: Render the solved results of an analysis as a contour plot an engineer (or you) can LOOK at: an SVG image (embedded z-buffered raster, parts hide each other correctly) of the outer skin of the meshed parts coloured by a field in 12 crisp bands (blue = low, red = high) with a colour legend in the analysis units, the MAX / MIN locations, supports (cyan dots), loads (magenta dots + arrow) and thermal BCs (orange dots; dots are drawn only where visible), on the deformed shape (structural fields; the scale is printed in the subtitle) over a faint silhouette of the undeformed part. field: von_mises (default for static / thermo-mechanical), u_mag, u_x, u_y, u_z, s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, temperature (default for heat_*), heat_flux, and cylindrical components about an axis (axisPoint + axisDirection, default: the z axis through the centre of the plotted parts bounding box; a quarter / half model needs the real axis point): s_hoop, s_radial, s_axial, u_radial. modal / buckling cases: field mode (default) colours the displacement magnitude of the mode shape normalised to 1 (it has no unit; mode = which mode, 1-based, default 1; the subtitle gives its frequency in Hz or its buckling factor; the shape is drawn deformed with the automatic scale because mode amplitudes are arbitrary); stress fields do not exist for them. To see an interior peak (e.g. under a PCB): cut = { normal, offset } removes the half-space dot(normal, p) > offset of the undeformed model and colours the section face by the field; entityIds plots only those parts (min / max and the colour range then refer to the plotted parts). With surface: true also data.surface { positions (flat xyz per triangle corner, deformed, document units), values (one per corner), triangles, truncated }. Returns data { svg, field, unit, resultSet, min { value, at }, max { value, at }, deformationScale, levels, trianglesDrawn, entityIds, cut, axis }; save it as PNG with the CLI (--save plot.png). Requires a solved analysis on this machine (fea_mesh then fea_solve). min.at / max.at / axis / target are in the analysis length unit; data.surface is in document units.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

axisDirection.description: s_hoop / s_radial / s_axial / u_radial: axis direction [x, y, z] (any non-zero length). Default [0, 0, 1].

axisPoint.description: s_hoop / s_radial / s_axial / u_radial: a point [x, y, z] (analysis length unit) on the axis. Default: centre of the plotted bounding box.

cut.description: One section plane, e.g. { normal: [0, 1, 0], offset: 0 } keeps y <= 0 and shows the field on the cut face.

normal.description: Plane normal [x, y, z] (any non-zero length); the side it points to is removed.

offset.description: Plane position: points with dot(unit normal, p) > offset are removed. Analysis length unit, undeformed mesh.

deformationScale.description: Displacement magnification of the drawn shape; 0 draws the undeformed shape. Default: automatic (structural fields).

direction.description: Custom viewing direction [x, y, z] from the part toward the viewer (overrides view), e.g. [0, -1, 0.3].

entityIds.description: Plot only these parts (entity ids of the analysis; the other parts are hidden). Default: every meshed part.

field.description: Field to colour by. Default: temperature for heat_steady / heat_transient, mode for modal / buckling, else von_mises.

height.description: Image height in pixels (240-2000). Default 640.

loadCase.description: Load case name of a static / thermo-mechanical case. Default: the first load case.

mode.description: modal / buckling only: mode number to plot (1 = lowest frequency / smallest buckling factor). Default 1.

range.description: Fixed colour range [min, max] (e.g. [0, 250] MPa) to compare plots; values outside fall in the end bands. Default: data range.

showMesh.description: Draw the element edges of the skin. Default false.

surface.description: Also return data.surface { positions, values, triangles, truncated }: the plotted triangles as flat xyz per corner (deformed, in DOCUMENT units) with one field value per corner, so a viewer can paint the contour on the model. Capped at 150000 corners. Default false.

target.description: Point [x, y, z] (analysis length unit, as data.max.at) kept at the centre when zoomed. Default: the part centre.

time.description: heat_transient: plot the result set nearest this time (s). Default: the last result set.

zoom.description: Magnification (1-50) about `target` to inspect a detail such as a hole edge. Default 1.

name: render_fea_results

description: SEE a simulated mechanism: runs the physics simulation (same engine and parameters as simulate_motion / plot_simulation) and renders the rigid bodies at chosen instants as a grid of frames, each labelled "t = 0.25 s", so crank rotation, piston travel or a pendulum swing can be checked without a screen. Pick instants with `times` (seconds, at most 12) or `frames` (N evenly spaced instants from 0 to the duration, both included; default 4). Every frame uses the same camera, so motion reads directly. `trace` draws the centre-of-mass path of the named rigid bodies (e.g. the coupler or the end-effector) over all samples, with a dot at the current position. Camera as render_view: `view` or `direction`. Returns data.svg (the grid), data.width/height, and data.frames[{ time, bodies{ bodyId: { position (centre of mass, document units), rotationDeg (Euler XYZ degrees from the start pose) } } }] to read numbers. Frames show the nearest recorded sample (data.frames[].time is that sample's time). With the CLI, `llull render_motion … --save m.png` writes a PNG rasterized from data.svg (--save m.svg writes the SVG itself; if rasterizing fails the .svg is saved instead and the CLI reply shows data.svg as a short placeholder). Point springs (add_spring) are drawn as green zig-zag coils between their attachment points, which ride on their bodies (data.frames[].springs gives the end points and length). Read-only; needs the physics engine like simulate_motion.

direction.description: Custom viewing direction [x, y, z] from the scene toward the camera (Z-up); overrides `view`.

duration.description: Simulated seconds. Default: the largest of `times`, else 5.

frames.description: Number of evenly spaced instants from 0 to the duration, both included (1..12). Default 4. Ignored when `times` is given.

height.description: Height of ONE frame in pixels, clamped to [64, 2000]. Default 320.

sampleRate.description: Recorded samples per second (the frames and the trace snap to these). Default as simulate_motion; raise it for a smoother trace.

times.description: Instants to draw, in seconds from the start (1 to 12 values, each within 0..duration). Overrides `frames`.

timestep.description: Integration step in seconds; default as simulate_motion.

trace.description: Rigid body id (or ids, at most 4) whose centre-of-mass path is drawn across all samples, e.g. the coupler or the piston.

view.description: Camera as render_view: "iso" (default), "top", "bottom", "front", "back", "left", "right". Planar mechanisms read best face-on.

width.description: Width of ONE frame in pixels, clamped to [64, 2000]. Default 420.

name: render_motion

description: Render the document to a self-contained SVG image string so an AI agent can SEE the scene and self-correct. Returns the unchanged document plus a `data` object containing: `svg` (complete SVG string), `view` (resolved view name), `width`, `height`, `entityCount`, `bounds` (world AABB or null), and `camera` ({position, target, up}). Choose `view` to orient the render: "iso" (default isometric), "top", "bottom", "front", "back", "left", or "right" (all orthographic). Adjust `width`/`height` (pixels, clamped to [64, 2000], default 800×600) for resolution. Solids are flat-Lambert shaded and depth-buffered per pixel (mode "raster", default: a PNG inside the SVG, outlines at creases and part boundaries) or drawn as sorted SVG polygons (mode "vector"); 2D shapes are stroked paths. Camera: `zoom` (>1 magnifies), `direction` ([x,y,z] vector from the scene toward the camera, overrides `view`), `target` (point to look at). `title` draws text top-left, `background` sets the image color. Cutaway: `cut` clips solids (triangles are split, not dropped) and draws the section as a hatched cap, e.g. remove the quadrant x>0,y<0 with planes [{normal:[1,0,0],offset:0},{normal:[0,-1,0],offset:0}] and mode "intersection". Large scenes are never silently truncated: the polygon budget (`maxPolygons`) is shared fairly between entities, and `data.simplifiedEntityIds` / `data.skippedEntityIds` / `data.polygonCount` report what was reduced. Enrichments: turntable (multi-frame strip), isolate (highlight entities), section (cut-plane view), showDimensions (bbox labels), showAxes (world triad, default on), showGrid (ground grid, default on), showLabels (entity id/name labels + key-point markers, default off). Does NOT modify the document; `affected` is always [].

background.description: Background CSS color: "#rrggbb", "#rgb", a color name ("white") or rgb()/hsl(). Default "#1a1a2e" (dark navy).

cut.description: Cutaway: clips the selected 3D solids against the planes (triangles are split exactly) and draws the exposed section as a light, hatched, outlined cap so solids do not look hollow. Rendered together with isolate/section/turntable.

entityIds.description: Entity ids to cut. Omit to cut every solid; other entities stay whole.

mode.description: "intersection" (default): remove only the region on the cut side of ALL planes (e.g. a quadrant or octant notch). "union": remove everything on the cut side of ANY plane.

planes.description: 1 to 6 cut planes. Each removes the half-space dot(unitNormal, p) > offset.

normal.description: Plane normal [x, y, z] (any non-zero length). It points to the REMOVED side.

offset.description: Plane position: points p with dot(unitNormal, p) = offset lie on the plane.

direction.description: Custom viewing direction: a non-zero [x, y, z] vector pointing from the scene center toward the camera (Z-up). Overrides `view`; e.g. [1,-1,0.5] looks from +X/-Y above. Result `view` is "custom".

height.description: Output image height in pixels. Clamped to [64, 2000]. Default: 600.

hide2D.description: When true, 2D sketch entities (lines, arcs, circles, polylines, rectangles, text, dimensions...) are neither drawn nor counted in the framing/bounds, so leftover construction sketches used for extrusions do not shrink the 3D part in the frame. Default: false (2D shapes are drawn and framed).

isolate.description: Entity id (or array of ids) to highlight. All other entities are rendered dimmed/desaturated; the specified id(s) are shown at full color.

maxPolygons.description: Polygon budget of vector mode, clamped to [500, 100000], default 20000 (raster mode allows at least 400000). Entities over their fair share are decimated (see data.simplifiedEntityIds); raise it for finer detail at the cost of a larger SVG.

mode.description: "raster" (default): solids are depth-buffered per pixel (always correct occlusion, crisp outlines) and embedded as a PNG in the SVG; "vector": every face is an SVG polygon sorted back to front (editable, but faces can draw through each other in dense scenes).

section.description: Render a section-plane view: entities on the negative side of the cut plane are dimmed; a colored dashed line marks the cut. axis: "x"|"y"|"z"; offset: world-space position of the plane.

axis.description: Axis normal to the cut plane: "x", "y", or "z".

offset.description: World-space position of the cut plane along the axis.

showAxes.description: When true (default), overlay a world-frame X/Y/Z axis triad anchored at the world origin. X=red, Y=green, Z=blue. A scale label (e.g. "1 mm = 42 px") is also shown. Set to false to suppress.

showDimensions.description: When true, overlay the bounding-box dimensions (W × D × H) as text labels on the image. Labels are placed near the bounding box edges in screen space.

showGrid.description: When true (default), overlay a faint ground grid on the Z=0 plane so you can judge object placement relative to the world origin. Set to false to suppress.

showLabels.description: When true, overlay per-entity id/name labels and key-point markers on the image. Each entity shows its name (or id) at the centroid of its key points (endpoints, center, corners, AABB corners for solids). Markers are color-coded by category: orange=point, cyan=2D curve, purple=3D solid, yellow=annotation. A legend appears in the top-right corner. Default: false (opt in to avoid clutter).

target.description: World point the camera looks at (default: center of the scene bounds). Combine with `zoom` to inspect a detail.

title.description: Text drawn top-left of the image (max 120 characters, longer is truncated).

turntable.description: Produce a horizontal strip of N evenly-spaced rotation frames around the Z (up) axis. frames: integer 1..12. When omitted, behavior is unchanged (single frame).

frames.description: Number of frames (1..12). Each frame is a separate rotated view stitched into one wide strip.

view.description: Camera direction. One of: "iso" (isometric — default, good for orienting in 3D), "top" (looking down the +Z axis), "bottom" (looking up the -Z axis), "front" (looking along the +Y axis), "back" (looking along the -Y axis), "left" (looking along the +X axis), "right" (looking along the -X axis). Omit for the default "iso" view.

width.description: Output image width in pixels. Clamped to [64, 2000]. Default: 800.

zoom.description: Magnification of the framed scene, clamped to [0.1, 50]. 1 (default) fits the whole scene; 3 shows a third of it.

name: render_view

description: Move a feature history step to a new position (0-based index) in the featureHistory list, then regenerate the document. Use to change the order in which operations are applied.

newIndex.description: Zero-based target index in featureHistory. Must be an integer; clamped to [0, history.length-1]. Moving to the same index is a no-op.

stepId.description: Id of the FeatureStep to move (from doc.featureHistory[*].id).

name: reorder_step

description: Recompute the document from scratch by replaying all non-suppressed steps in featureHistory in order. Use after manually editing the history list or to verify the document is consistent with its feature recipe.
name: replay_history

description: Fill the records of private (licensed) material libraries from the library files held on this machine. A saved document keeps only { libraryId, version, sha256 } for them; run this after load_document. A record is filled only when the file has exactly the pinned sha256; otherwise it stays unresolved (provider missing, library missing or hash mismatch) and mass_properties / get_material_allowable answer available: false with MAT_LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED. This is a session command: it is not recorded in the feature history and never saved. Register a file first with register_material_library; import a new version explicitly with import_material_library.
name: resolve_material_libraries

description: Create a surface of revolution by rotating a closed 2D profile around an axis. Right-handed world frame, +Z up. Either pass profile, an array of [x, y] points where x is the radial offset from the axis and y is the axial offset (at least 3 points, implicitly closed), or profileIds: drawn 2D sketch entities (spline, arc, line, polyline, circle, ellipse) that form one closed loop, read in their sketch-plane coordinates (x = radial, y = axial). A sketched profile keeps its exact curves (smooth bell nozzles, domes, fillets) for the exact kernel and STEP export. axis controls the revolution axis: "x", "y", or "z" (shorthand), or a [dx,dy,dz] direction vector. Default axis is "z" (+Z up, the natural axis for a Z-up document). angle is the sweep in radians (default 2π for a full revolution; must be > 0). segments is the number of radial subdivisions (default 32, minimum 3). Stores a parametric revolution entity; tessellated as triangles in render_view and export_stl.

angle.description: Sweep angle in radians. Must be > 0. Default: 2π (full 360° revolution). Use π for a half-revolution, π/2 for a quarter, etc.

axis.description: Revolution axis. Use "x", "y", or "z" for the principal axes, or pass a [dx, dy, dz] array for an arbitrary direction (it will be normalised). Default: "z" (natural +Z-up axis).

color.description: Hex color string #rrggbb, e.g. "#c8553d". Defaults to "#6b8f9c".

id.description: Optional explicit entity id. If omitted a unique id is generated.

layerId.description: Layer id to assign the entity to. Defaults to the document default layer.

position.description: World-space origin of the revolution axis [x, y, z] in document units. Default: [0, 0, 0]. Format [x, y, z]; [x, y] is accepted and placed at z=0.

profile.description: Closed polygon cross-section: array of [x, y] points. x = radial offset from the axis (≥ 0 for outward), y = axial offset along the axis. Minimum 3 points. The polygon is implicitly closed — do NOT repeat the first point at the end. Omit when profileIds is given.

profileIds.description: Ids of coplanar 2D sketch entities forming one closed loop (one closed shape, or open pieces such as a spline plus lines that join end to end in any order). Their sketch-plane x is the radial offset, y the axial offset; curves are kept exact. Alternative to profile.

rotation.description: three.js intrinsic XYZ Euler angles in RADIANS [rx, ry, rz] (equivalent to rotating about world Z first, then world Y, then world X) applied after revolution. Default: [0, 0, 0]. Malformed or non-length-3 values are ignored and [0,0,0] is used.

segments.description: Number of radial subdivisions for tessellation. Integer; higher = smoother surface. Default: 32. Minimum: 3 (smaller values are raised to 3).

name: revolve_profile

description: Read-only power <-> steady speed of any road vehicle (bicycle, e-bike, car, truck): aerodynamic drag ½ρ(CdA+Fw)V_A²V, rolling resistance Crr·m·g·cos θ·V, climbing m·g·sin θ·V, wind and drivetrain efficiency. Give exactly one of `speed` (+ speedUnit) or `powerW` (drivetrain input power; the steady speed is solved). `vehicle` generic (default: `crr` required, no wheel / bearing terms, efficiency 1 = power at the wheels) or bicycle (Martin et al. 1998 road-cycling preset, validated R² 0.97, SE 2.7 W: Crr 0.0032, wheel drag Fw 0.0044 m², bearing loss V(91 + 8.7·V) mW, chain 0.976; rider + bike CdA upright ≈ 0.27, drops ≈ 0.24, time trial ≈ 0.21 m², Defraeye 2010). `massKg` total moving mass; drag area `cdA` m² or `cd` + `entityIds` (frontal area of the model); `gradePercent`; `headwindMS` (+ head / - tail); air from altitudeM (standard atmosphere) or densityKgM3. model `bassett_1999`: track-cycling hour records (Bassett et al. 1999 eq. 8, velodrome, no wind): `riderHeightM`, `riderMassKg`, bike 10 kg, aerodynamic factor `k1` (or the density ratio of `altitudeM` (or `densityKgM3` / 1.225) × position / bike / clothing / helmet factors). Returns the power breakdown (aero, rolling, bearings, gravity, drivetrain), speed and the 1-hour distance; every defaulted input is flagged.

altitudeM.description: Geometric altitude in m for the U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 (-5000..86000). Default 0 (sea level) unless densityKgM3 is given.

bearingLosses.description: road_load: add the bicycle wheel-bearing loss V(91 + 8.7·V) mW (bicycle default true, generic false).

bikeFactor.description: bassett: Kb (0.93 aero bike, 1.07 drop bars + spoked wheels). Default 1.

bikeMassKg.description: bassett: bicycle mass in kg (default 10, the paper value).

cd.description: road_load: drag coefficient on the frontal area of entityIds.

cdA.description: road_load: drag area CdA in m² (> 0). Or cd + entityIds.

crr.description: road_load: rolling resistance coefficient, 0..0.1. Required for generic; bicycle default 0.0032 (Martin 1998 road tyres).

densityKgM3.description: Air density in kg/m³ (> 0) instead of the standard atmosphere, e.g. a measured value.

drivetrainEfficiency.description: road_load: drivetrain efficiency in (0, 1] (bicycle default 0.976; generic default 1 = power at the wheels).

entityIds.description: road_load: vehicle (+ rider) solids; frontal area along flowDirection (default [1, 0, 0]).

flowDirection.description: Direction the air moves relative to the body [x, y, z] (any length, not zero). Default [1, 0, 0]: a body moving along -x.

gradePercent.description: road_load: road grade in % (rise / run × 100, -25..25). Default 0.

headwindMS.description: road_load: wind along the road in m/s, + headwind / - tailwind. Default 0.

helmetFactor.description: bassett: Kh (1.025-1.04 no aero helmet). Default 1.

k1.description: bassett: aerodynamic factor K1 = Kd·Kpo·Kb·Kc·Kh (overrides the factors below).

massKg.description: road_load: total moving mass in kg (vehicle + rider / payload, > 0). Required.

model.description: road_load (default: any road vehicle, Martin et al. 1998 terms) or bassett_1999 (track cycling hour record, Bassett et al. 1999).

positionFactor.description: bassett: Kpo (e.g. 1.0 aero bars, 0.95 Superman, 0.96 Obree, 1.08 drop bars). Default 1.

powerW.description: Power at the drivetrain input in W (crank, motor shaft; > 0); the command solves the steady speed. Give this or speed.

resolution.description: Silhouette grid cells along its larger extent, 50..2000. Default 400 (area error ~ ±0.5 %).

riderHeightM.description: bassett: rider height in m (1.4..2.2). Required.

riderMassKg.description: bassett: rider mass in kg (40..120). Required.

speed.description: Speed (air speed for aircraft, ground speed for road vehicles) in speedUnit, >= 0.

speedUnit.description: Unit of speed: m/s (default), km/h, kn (knot, 1852 m/h) or mph.

temperatureOffsetK.description: ISA temperature deviation ΔT in K at the standard pressure (e.g. 15 for ISA+15). Default 0.

trackFactor.description: bassett: K, external conditions (track roughness). Default 1.

vehicle.description: road_load: generic (default: crr required, no wheel / bearing terms, drivetrain 1) or bicycle (Martin 1998 preset: crr 0.0032, Fw 0.0044 m², bearing loss, drivetrain 0.976).

viscosityPaS.description: Dynamic viscosity in Pa·s with densityKgM3; default Sutherland at 288.15 K + temperatureOffsetK (1.7894e-5 Pa·s).

wheelAreaM2.description: road_load: wheel rotation drag area Fw in m², added to CdA (bicycle default 0.0044, generic 0).

name: road_load_power

description: Read-only ideal velocity change of a rocket stage by the Tsiolkovsky equation Δv = Isp·g0·ln(m0/mf) (no gravity or drag losses), from `ispS` (s, e.g. nozzle_performance vacuum Isp) and the masses: `initialMassKg` with `propellantMassKg` (or `finalMassKg`). Optional `thrustN` gives the mass flow and burn time. Or give `targetDeltaVMS` instead of the propellant / final mass to get the propellant needed.

finalMassKg.description: Final (burn-out) mass in kg, 0 < mf < m0.

propellantMassKg.description: Propellant burned in kg, 0 < m_p < m0.

targetDeltaVMS.description: Wanted Δv in m/s (> 0): returns the propellant mass needed.

thrustN.description: Thrust in N (> 0) for mass flow and burn time.

name: rocket_delta_v

description: Add Euler-angle deltas (radians) to an entity rotation. Modifies only the rotation field; position and geometry are unchanged.

delta.description: Euler-angle increments [dRx, dRy, dRz] in radians to add to the current rotation.

id.description: Id of the entity to rotate.

name: rotate_entity

description: Run several reliability methods on ONE limit state and compare them: "form" (Hasofer-Lind / Rackwitz-Fiessler with Nataf), "sorm" (FORM + Breitung curvature correction), "mc" (seeded Monte Carlo or Latin hypercube, needs `seed`) and "fosm" (first-order second-moment). Default methods: form, mc, fosm. Returns data { form, sorm, monteCarlo, fosm, comparison { pf: { method: Pf }, formInsideMonteCarloInterval }, items[], reviewRequired: true } and the item PRB_FORM_MC_DISAGREE when the FORM Pf falls outside the Monte Carlo Wilson 95 % interval (report the Monte Carlo value, consider SORM). Same data shapes as reliability_form and propagate_uncertainty. Computed by llull, not approved: a qualified engineer must review before any certification decision.

methods.description: Methods to run, any of form, sorm, mc, fosm. Default ["form", "mc", "fosm"].

sampling.description: Sampling scheme of the "mc" method. Default "lhs".

seed.description: Integer seed in [0, 4294967295] of the PRNG (xoshiro128**); the same model, method, samples and seed give bit-identical results.

tolerance.description: FORM stops when no u component changes by more than this (default 1e-8).

name: run_reliability_study

description: Sample a material property along one variable (e.g. k from 4 K to 300 K): `count` points (default 101, at most 1000), linear or log spacing; optionally the integral ∫ y dx (e.g. the conductivity integral in W/m, adaptive Gauss-Kronrod) and a piecewise-linear solver table whose linear interpolation stays within relTol (default 1e-3) of the model, for solver decks. Same range rules as evaluate_property: from / to must lie in the valid range (PROP_OUT_OF_RANGE). Read-only; numbers behind a property chart.

count.description: Number of samples, endpoints included (default 101, max 1000).

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 'K', 'degC', 'degF', '1/s'.

fixed.description: Values of the other variables, each with its unit.

from.description: Start of the sweep with its unit.

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 'K', 'degC', 'degF', '1/s'.

integrate.description: Also return ∫ y d(variable) over [from, to].

outputUnit.description: Unit of y. Default: the model unit.

solverTable.description: Also return a piecewise-linear solver table (for solver decks).

solverTableRelTol.description: Max relative linear-interpolation error of the solver table (default 1e-3).

spacing.description: Sample spacing (log needs from > 0). Default linear.

to.description: End of the sweep with its unit (> from).

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 'K', 'degC', 'degF', '1/s'.

name: sample_property

description: Snapshot the current featureHistory into a named recipe stored in the document. A recipe is a saved constructive sequence that can be re-instantiated any number of times (on this or any document) via instantiate_recipe, each time producing independent entities with fresh ids. Saving does NOT change any geometry. If a recipe with the same name already exists it is replaced.

label.description: Optional human/AI note describing the recipe's purpose, e.g. "L-bracket with 3 holes".

name.description: Unique lookup key for the recipe, e.g. "bracket_v1", "wheel_assembly". Must be a non-empty, non-whitespace-only string. Used as both the display name and the key for instantiate_recipe.

name: save_recipe

description: Uniformly scale an entity by a positive factor. Scales geometry in-place for all kinds — 3D: box size, cylinder radius & height, sphere radius, extrusion profile & depth; 2D: line/polyline points, arc/circle/ellipse radii, rectangle width & height, spline points (about the local origin). Position is unchanged.

factor.description: Uniform scale factor. Must be greater than 0. A value of 2 doubles the size; 0.5 halves it.

id.description: Id of the entity to scale.

name: scale_entity

description: Select the fastener for a stack (read-only): grip dash, part number, shim washers, length and thread protrusion. Give family and diameterDash (list_fastener_families), and the stack either as stack { value, unit } or as stackIds + axisPoint (+ axis) measured along the axis. Optional nut and washer family ids (same diameter dash) enable the protrusion check and shimming. Bolts use the smallest grip >= stack (washers fill the gap, total <= 1/8 in by default, at most 3); Hi-Lok pins use the grip whose range contains the stack; rivets use stack + 1.5 D rounded to the catalogue step. Every rule left at its default is listed in data.rules with source and defaulted: true. Failures return data.ok = false with reasons[] (FAST_STACK_OUT_OF_RANGE, FAST_WASHER_GAP, FAST_PROTRUSION_SHORT, ...). All lengths in data are inches (…In). Next: insert_fastener_stack.

axis.description: Fastener axis direction [x, y, z] pointing from the head side to the nut side. Default [0, 0, 1].

axisPoint.description: Point [x, y, z] in document units the fastener axis passes through (with stackIds). Not required with stack.

codes.description: Part-number code choices by grammar field name, e.g. { "material": "AD" } for MS20470AD4. A missing choice takes the first catalogue code and is reported.

diameterDash.description: Size dash of the family as listed by list_fastener_families (e.g. "3" for NAS6203, "4" for MS20470AD4, "8" for HL19 1/4 in).

family.description: Id of the fastener family in the document catalogue (e.g. "NAS6203-6220", "MS20470", "HL19"). Use list_fastener_families to see ids.

maxWasherTotal.description: Largest combined washer thickness allowed as { value, unit }. Default 1/8 in (AC 43.13-1B 7-37), reported as a defaulted rule

unit.description: Length unit of the value, e.g. 'in', 'mm', 'ft'.

nut.description: Optional nut family id (e.g. "MS21042") for the same diameter dash; enables the thread-protrusion check.

rivetRounding.description: Rivet length rounding to the catalogue step: "up" or "nearest". Default: the catalogue rule (up), reported as a defaulted rule.

stack.description: Stack thickness to fasten (total thickness of the joined layers) as { value, unit }. Give this OR stackIds

unit.description: Length unit of the value, e.g. 'in', 'mm', 'ft'.

stackIds.description: Ids of the 3D solids (plates) the fastener passes through; their thickness along the axis is measured. Give this OR stack. Needs axisPoint.

washer.description: Optional washer family id (e.g. "NAS1149") used to shim the gap between grip and stack.

washerSide.description: Side of the stack the shim washers go on: "nut" (default) or "head".

name: select_fastener

description: Set the active level: new building elements go there when no levelId is given.

levelId.description: Level id, e.g. "level-1".

name: set_active_level

description: Set the vertical design profile of an alignment from PVIs [{ station, elevation, curveLength? }] (document units). Grades are straight between PVIs; an interior PVI with `curveLength` > 0 gets a symmetric parabolic vertical curve centred on it (first / last PVI cannot). The first and last PVI stations must lie within the alignment stations. The summary lists grades and K values.

pvis.description: At least 2 PVIs; sorted by station automatically.

elevation.description: Design elevation at the PVI, document units.

name: set_alignment_profile

description: Set one or more camera fields (target, azimuth, polar, distance). Unspecified fields are preserved, so target alone re-centres the orbit on a point (optionally with azimuth/polar to also change direction) without changing the distance. target is [x,y,z] world-space orbit centre. azimuth is horizontal angle in radians (XY plane, measured from +Y toward +X). polar is vertical angle in radians (0 = overhead along +Z, π/2 = eye-level). distance is the radius of the orbit sphere; must be > 0. Does NOT add to feature history.

azimuth.description: Horizontal orbit angle in radians measured in the XY plane from +Y toward +X. Eye offset from target is (sin a, cos a) in XY: 0 = eye at +Y (back view), π = eye at -Y (front view), π/2 = eye at +X (right view). Omit to keep current value.

distance.description: Orbit radius — distance from target to camera eye. Must be > 0. Omit to keep current value.

polar.description: Vertical orbit angle in radians. 0 = overhead (along +Z), π/2 = eye-level. Clamped to [0.01, π−0.01] to avoid gimbal lock. Omit to keep current value.

target.description: World-space orbit target [x, y, z]. Omit to keep current target.

name: set_camera

description: Declare the coordinate reference system of the civil model (projected grid), e.g. name "RGF93 / Lambert-93", epsg 2154, verticalDatum "NGF-IGN69". Written to LandXML (<CoordinateSystem>). Keeps an existing site calibration (set_site_calibration).

epsg.description: EPSG code of the projected CRS (positive integer), e.g. 2154.

name.description: CRS name, e.g. "RGF93 / Lambert-93". Must not be empty.

name: set_coordinate_system

description: Set the correlation of random variables (replaces any previous matrix). `names` lists the variables, `matrix` is their correlation matrix (symmetric, ones on the diagonal, off-diagonals in (-1, 1), positive definite). Variables not listed stay independent. For non-normal marginals the correlation is the correlation of the values X (a Nataf transform is applied, so a pair whose correlation is not attainable for its distributions is refused).

matrix.description: Correlation matrix, names.length x names.length, e.g. [[1, 0.5], [0.5, 1]].

names.description: Names of at least two defined random variables, in the order of the matrix rows.

name: set_correlation

description: Store unit rates (price per unit) in the project for estimate_cost. Keys are takeoff keys "<category>.<material>.<unit>" (e.g. "wall.concrete.m3": 180, "door.timber.ea": 450) or wildcards "wall.*.m2", "slab-roof.*.m3" (slab groups: slab-floor, slab-roof, slab-foundation) or "*.concrete.m3". Price ONE unit per category to avoid double counting.

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. "EUR". Default kept / "EUR".

rates.description: Map of rate key → price per unit (>= 0).

replace.description: Replace all stored rates instead of merging. Default false.

name: set_cost_rates

description: Set the named factors of a crack-growth case: scatterThreshold and scatterInterval {value >= 1, source} (NO default: ask the owner) and marginalBand. compute_inspection_interval divides the life from aDetectable to the critical size by scatterInterval.

marginalBand.description: Margin band (>= 0) for check_damage_tolerance. No default.

scatterInterval.description: Factor on the inspection interval life (aDetectable -> critical). No default.

source.description: Mandatory source of the factor (regulation, company rule, case input).

scatterThreshold.description: Factor on the threshold life (aInitial -> critical). No default.

source.description: Mandatory source of the factor (regulation, company rule, case input).

name: set_damage_tolerance_factors

description: Tune how simulate_motion integrates a loop-closed mechanism (slider-crank, four-bar, engine). Defaults are right for most models; change them when data.loops.tier of simulate_motion is "warn" or "fail" (FPR_LOOP_DRIFT) or the run diverges. timestepS: seconds, or "auto" (default) = min(1 ms, 0.5 deg of crank at the top speed). integrator: "rk4" (default) or "implicitfast". loopTimeConstantSteps (>= 2, default 2): the loop constraints relax over this many timesteps; 2 is the stiffest stable value and keeps light links (rods of a few grams) closed, but resolves the closure so coarsely that a slider-crank torque (0.5 kg piston, 5 g rod) is 0.7 % off: when crank torque accuracy matters use 8 (0.03 %) to 16 (0.01 %), and check data.loops.tier stays "pass". loopImpedance (0 < d <= 0.9999, default 0.9999): closer to 1 = stiffer loop. loopResidualPassM (default 1e-6 m = 1 µm, 5 % of a 0.020 mm pin clearance) and loopResidualFailM (default 1e-5 m): residual tiers. timestepSensitivityGate (default 0.01): reserved for the half-timestep check. Only the given fields change. Next: simulate_motion and read data.loops.

loopResidualFailM.description: Loop residual (m) above which a run fails. Default 1e-5.

loopResidualPassM.description: Loop residual (m) up to which a run passes. Default 1e-6.

loopTimeConstantSteps.description: Loop constraint time constant in timesteps, >= 2 (default 2).

timestepSensitivityGate.description: Relative change gate of the half-timestep check. Default 0.01.

name: set_dynamics_solver

description: Move an entity to a different layer by updating its layerId. Graceful no-op if the entity or target layer does not exist. Rejected (graceful no-op) if the entity currently resides on a LOCKED layer — unlock the source layer first before reassigning its entities.

entityId.description: Id of the entity to reassign to a different layer.

layerId.description: Id of the destination layer. Must exist in the document.

name: set_entity_layer

description: Set an entity's display name and/or tags. Both fields are optional and independent — omitting a field leaves it unchanged. Pass name:"" to clear the name, or tags:[] to clear all tags. Enables AI/CLI plans to reference entities by meaning instead of generated ids, and allows `find_entities` to filter by name or tag.

id.description: Id of the entity to label.

name.description: New display name for the entity, e.g. "Left wall". Omit to leave the existing name unchanged; pass an empty string to clear it.

tags.description: Array of semantic tag strings to assign, e.g. ["structural","visible"]. Omit to leave existing tags unchanged. Pass [] to clear all tags.

name: set_entity_name

description: Set the export-control marking (none, EAR99, EAR + eccn, ITAR) of a material record. Raising a marking is always allowed. Lowering it (for example ITAR → none) is a human act: it needs `confirmation`, a signature produced in the desktop app; an agent gets MAT_HUMAN_GATE. Export commands refuse documents that use EAR or ITAR records (MAT_EXPORT_CONTROLLED).

confirmation.description: Human signature object, required only to lower the marking.

category.description: USML category for ITAR, e.g. "XIII(g)"; optional.

eccn.description: Export Control Classification Number, e.g. "1C002"; required for regime EAR.

regime.description: Export-control regime: none, EAR99, EAR (needs eccn) or ITAR. EAR and ITAR content is gated on export.

material.description: Material id of a record (define_material_record or a library record).

name: set_export_marking

description: Set the named factors of a fatigue case: scatter {value >= 1, source} (NO default: ask the owner), Miner damageLimit (default 1), marginalBand, Marin modifiers (surface / size / reliability / environment / other: value > 0 multiplying the curve strength, each with a justification; REPLACES the list) and compressiveMean (no_benefit | formula). Fields you omit keep their value.

compressiveMean.description: Compressive mean-stress rule: no_benefit (default, conservative) or formula.

damageLimit.description: Miner damage limit D (> 0). Default 1 (Palmgren-Miner rule), reported as defaulted.

marginalBand.description: Margin band (>= 0): 0 <= margin < band is MARGINAL. No default.

modifiers.description: REPLACES the Marin modifier list (surface, size, reliability, ...). Each needs value > 0 and a justification.

justification.description: Mandatory reason / source of the factor.

value.description: Factor > 0 multiplying the curve strength (0.8 = 20 % weaker than the test specimen). Never defaulted.

scatter.description: Scatter factor SF on life. There is NO default: without it compute_fatigue refuses with FAT_SCATTER_FACTOR_UNSET.
