source.description: Mandatory source of the factor (regulation, company rule, case input).

name: set_fatigue_factors

description: Set the gravity vector of the physics simulation in m/s², world axes. Default [0, 0, -9.81] (Z up, Earth). [0, 0, 0] = weightless (isolates a mechanism from its own weight); [0, 0, -1.62] = Moon.

gravity.description: Gravity acceleration [x, y, z] in m/s².

name: set_gravity

description: Set the uniform initial temperature of a heat_steady / heat_transient analysis (value + unit degC | K | degF). MANDATORY for a transient (never defaulted); for a steady case it is only the start of the nonlinear iteration (useful with radiation). Written as *INITIAL CONDITIONS on every node.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

unit.description: Temperature unit: 'degC', 'K' or 'degF'.

name: set_initial_temperature

description: Set the current value of a kinematic joint. For revolute joints, "value" is the rotation angle in radians. For prismatic joints, "value" is the displacement in document units. "value" may be a plain number or a parameter expression string (e.g. "=spoke_angle * 2" or "gap / 3"). Expression strings are stored as-is and evaluated when evaluate_motion or bake_motion is called. Call evaluate_motion (query) or bake_motion (mutates doc) to apply the new value to instance transforms.

id.description: Id of the joint to update. Must exist in doc.joints.

value.description: New joint value. For revolute: angle in radians. For prismatic: displacement in document units. May be a plain number ("1.5708") or a parameter expression string ("spoke_angle * 2"). Expression strings reference named parameters in doc.parameters.

name: set_joint_value

description: Add a sourced property value to a material: density, E, Ec, G, nu, Ftu, Fty, Fcy, Fsu, Fbru, Fbry, elongation, cte, k, cp. Give value + unit (any unit of the right dimension: g/cm^3, lb/in^3, ksi, MPa, Msi, GPa), the basis (A, B, S, typical, supplier_unstated, company, unspecified; REQUIRED for strengths) and the source (citation + locator, REQUIRED). Optional keys: direction (L, LT, ST, isotropic …), thickness range, e/D for bearing, and a temperature table (absolute values or percent of the room-temperature value). Several values may coexist (two supplier densities); mark at most one preferred per key. Values of typical / supplier_unstated / unspecified basis are flagged unverified downstream. Stored as a PHY-01 property model, so evaluate_property and get_material_allowable read it. Records imported from a library are read-only. Next: get_material_allowable, mass_properties, check_materials.

basis.description: A | B | S | typical | supplier_unstated | company | unspecified. Required for strengths; default unspecified (unverified).

direction.description: Grain / material direction: L, LT, ST, 1, 2, 3, normal, warp, fill, or isotropic (same as omitted).

edOverD.description: Bearing edge-distance ratio e/D (1.5 or 2.0) of an Fbru / Fbry value.

id.description: Id of the value on the material (default derived from the key, e.g. "Ftu.L.A.t0p02-0p128").

material.description: Material id (the name given to create_material or the id of define_material_record).

preferred.description: Mark as THE value for its key (at most one preferred per property, direction, basis, thickness, e/D).

property.description: Property: density, E, Ec, G, nu, Ftu, Fty, Fcy, Fsu, Fbru, Fbry, elongation, cte, k, cp.

replace.description: Replace an existing value with the same id (default false: PROP_MODEL_EXISTS).

source.description: Provenance of the value. REQUIRED.

citation.description: Bibliographic citation of the value, e.g. "MIL-HDBK-5J". Required; blank is MAT_PROVENANCE_MISSING.

temperature.description: Temperature dependence; the room-temperature value is a separate call without temperature.

exposureHours.description: Exposure time at temperature in hours (MIL-HDBK-5 exposure curves); part of the value key.

mode.description: absolute: points are [temperature, value] in `unit`; percentOfRT: points are [temperature, percent of the room-temperature value].

points.description: [[temperature, value or percent], …], at least 2, temperatures strictly increasing. Evaluation is linear and never extrapolates.

rtModelId.description: percentOfRT only: id of the room-temperature model the percentages scale. Default: the only constant model with the same property, basis, direction, thickness and e/D.

temperatureUnit.description: Unit of the temperature column of points.

thickness.description: Product thickness range of the value (allowables are tabulated per thickness range).

max.description: Largest product thickness the value applies to.

min.description: Smallest product thickness the value applies to.

unit.description: Length unit, e.g. 'in' or 'mm'.
Unit of the value, e.g. 'g/cm^3', 'lb/in^3', 'ksi', 'MPa', 'GPa', '1' (dimensionless), '%'.

value.description: The value in `unit` (room temperature). Omit when a temperature table is given.

name: set_material_property

description: Set the tetrahedral mesh controls of an analysis (Gmsh): element order (1 = linear C3D4, 2 = quadratic C3D10, default 2; use 2 for stress), globalSize (target element edge length, document units, > 0), optional minSize and refinements (local size at points near faces / edges / vertices of a part, size <= globalSize). Only the given fields change. Lengths are in document units. Changing the mesh makes a recorded mesh and results stale (describe_analysis shows the state); the host re-runs fea_mesh.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

bonding.description: How touching parts of a multi-part analysis are meshed. "separate" (default): one independent volume per part, no shared nodes (needed for contact). "conformal": all parts are fragmented in one Gmsh model so touching parts share their interface nodes (bonded / perfectly glued parts; each part keeps its own element set and material). Conformal needs exact STEP geometry (OCC kernel) and parts that only touch (do not overlap: subtract one from the other first); otherwise fea_mesh is refused.

globalSize.description: Target element edge length in document units, > 0.

minSize.description: Smallest allowed element size in document units, > 0 and <= globalSize.

refinements.description: Replaces the whole refinement list (empty array clears it).

size.description: Element size at the target, document units, <= globalSize.

target.description: Faces / edges / points to refine (points near them, document units).

edgesNear.description: Points identifying edges: each resolves to the nearest edge.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended edge.

entityId.description: Id of the analysed 3D entity (it must be a part of the analysis: set_part_idealization).

facesNear.description: Points identifying faces: each resolves to the NEAREST face of the entity at meshing time.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended face.

intersectPlane.description: Optional: restrict the target to the curve where the faces meet this plane.

normal.description: Plane normal (need not be unit length).

pointsNear.description: Points identifying vertices / locations: each resolves to the nearest vertex or node.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended vertex or location.

name: set_mesh_controls

description: Set the document modelling tolerances used by exact (B-rep) work. linear (mm, range 1e-7 to 1e-2, default 1e-4) is the heal / sew / STEP import precision; angular (rad, range 1e-12 to 1e-3, default 1e-9); maxImportTolerance (mm, range 1e-7 to 1, default 0.01, not below linear) is the threshold above which import_step_exact warns KRN_IMPORT_TOLERANCE_HIGH. Pass only the values to change. Out-of-range values are refused with KRN_TOLERANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE. Read the current values with kernel_info.

angular.description: Angular modelling tolerance in radians; 1e-12 to 1e-3. Default 1e-9.

linear.description: Linear modelling tolerance in millimetres (NOT document units); 1e-7 to 1e-2. Default 1e-4.

maxImportTolerance.description: Warn threshold in millimetres for sub-shape tolerances after STEP import / heal; 1e-7 to 1, at least linear. Default 0.01.

name: set_modeling_tolerance

description: Set the global controls of a nonlinear_static analysis (CalculiX): nlgeom (REQUIRED, no default: true = large displacement / *STEP NLGEOM, false = small displacement with material nonlinearity only), the convergence criteria and which increments are stored. convergence: name "ccx_default" (no *CONTROLS card, CalculiX defaults) or "custom" with field (the *CONTROLS FIELD tolerances R_n, C_n, ...) and/or timeIncrementation (I_0 ... I_T). outputIncrements: "all" (every increment, a curve point per increment; default), "last_per_step" or { every: n }. Creates the nonlinear settings of the case on first use and keeps existing steps, probes and constitutive sets on later calls. Next: set_part_constitutive_set, add_analysis_step, add_curve_probe, then the host runs fea_mesh and fea_solve.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

field.description: custom only: *CONTROLS PARAMETERS=FIELD tolerances, key -> number > 0; unlisted keys keep the CalculiX default. Keys: Rn (largest residual force relative to the average force, default 0.005), Cn (largest correction relative to the largest incremental solution, 0.02), q0 and qu (force thresholds below which a residual is zero, automatic), Rp (residual tolerance of the 2nd check, 0.02), eps (correction tolerance of the 2nd check, 1e-5), Ceps (largest correction at a node with a low residual, 0.001), Rl (line-search residual tolerance, 1e-8).

name.description: ccx_default = CalculiX defaults (no *CONTROLS); custom = the values below.

timeIncrementation.description: custom only: *CONTROLS PARAMETERS=TIME INCREMENTATION values, key -> integer > 0; unlisted keys keep the CalculiX default. Keys: I0 (iterations before a stagnating residual may be accepted, 4), IR (iterations before the convergence rate is checked, 8), IP (iterations before the looser tolerance applies, 9), IC (iterations after which divergence is assumed, 16), IL (iterations beyond which the next increment shrinks, 10), IG (iterations below which it grows, 4), IS (iterations of the cutback test, 12), IA (maximum cutbacks of an increment, 5), IJ (iterations between Jacobian updates, 6), IT (maximum iterations per increment, 200).

nlgeom.description: true = geometric nonlinearity (large displacements, *STEP NLGEOM); false = small displacements (refused when a part uses a hyperelastic set: CalculiX forces NLGEOM for those). Always state it.

outputIncrements.description: Which increments are stored for fields and curve probes: "all" (default), "last_per_step" or { every: n }.

name: set_nonlinear_controls

description: Create or update a named numeric parameter in the document. The expression may be a numeric literal (e.g. "10") or reference other parameters by name using +, -, *, / and parentheses (e.g. "width * 2 + 5"). After setting the parameter, all dependent parameters are re-evaluated in topological order. An invalid expression is stored with an error message rather than rejecting the call. Parameter names must be non-empty strings containing only letters, digits, and underscores.

expression.description: Numeric expression defining the parameter value. May be a plain number ("10", "3.14") or a formula referencing other parameter names ("width * 2", "base_height + offset", "(a + b) / 2"). Supports +, -, *, /, parentheses, unary minus, and decimal numbers.

name.description: Parameter name used as its identifier and in expressions that reference it. Must be non-empty and contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), digits, and underscores. Example: "width", "wall_thickness", "radius2".

name: set_parameter

description: Choose the constitutive set (elastic + plastic / hyperelastic behaviour, from define_constitutive_set on the part material) that a part uses in a nonlinear_static analysis. The deck then carries that set's CalculiX cards (*ELASTIC, *PLASTIC, ...) exactly as export_material_cards writes them; no stress-strain values are stored in the analysis. Omit constitutiveSetId to use the material's default set (the summary names it). Sets with creep, viscoelastic or rate laws are refused for a static step. Parts that share a material must use the same set. Needs the part (set_part_idealization) and its assigned material.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

constitutiveSetId.description: Id of a ConstitutiveSet of the part's material record (define_constitutive_set). Default: the material's default set.

entityId.description: Id of a part of the analysis (set_part_idealization).

name: set_part_constitutive_set

description: Mark 3D entities or instances as attached to the world (grounded = true) or release them (false). check_assembly treats a part that is grounded, belongs to a fixed rigid body or is the child of a joint whose parent is the ground as an anchor: every part must connect to an anchor through joints, rigid bodies, fasteners or contact, else FPR_PART_FLOATING. Use it for frames, stands and bolted-down parts that have no dynamics body. Unknown or 2D ids and a request that changes nothing are no-ops. Next: check_assembly.

grounded.description: true = attach to the world, false = release.

ids.description: Entity or instance ids to mark.

name: set_part_grounded

description: Add a 3D solid to an analysis as a meshed part (idealization "solid": full 3D tetrahedral continuum, the only one built). Constraints, loads, thermal conditions and refinements may only target entities that are parts. The part needs a material (assign_material) before solving. plane_stress and shell are refused as not built.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

entityId.description: Id of the 3D solid entity to analyse (box, cylinder, extrusion, boolean result, mesh solid, ...).

idealization.description: Only "solid" is built (default); the others are refused with FEA_IDEALIZATION_UNSUPPORTED.

name: set_part_idealization

description: Set project metadata used by plan-sheet title blocks and IFC export: project name, client, site address, author, drawing number, revision, date. Omitted fields are kept.

date.description: Issue date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-10-01" (other formats are not used for the IFC header).

name: set_project_info

description: Set the stress-free (reference) temperature of a thermo_static or coupled_temperature_displacement analysis: the temperature at which the parts carry no thermal strain. Thermal strain is the secant CTE times (T - reference), and the reference is also the initial temperature of the solve. There is no default; it must be stated with a unit (degC, K, degF). Changing it makes recorded mesh-independent results stale.

analysisId.description: Id of a thermo_static or coupled_temperature_displacement analysis.

unit.description: Temperature unit: degC, K or degF.

name: set_reference_temperature

description: Set the symmetric road template of an alignment: carriageway `laneWidth` and `shoulderWidth` each side of the centreline (document units), `crossfall` (ratio falling away from the centreline, 0.025 = 2.5 %), and the `cutSlope` / `fillSlope` batters (horizontal per 1 vertical). Defaults: 3.5 m lane, 1.0 m shoulder, 0.025, 1.5, 2.0 - or the current template values. With a profile the corridor is drawn; with a surface too, batters run to daylight.

cutSlope.description: Cut batter H per 1 V (> 0). Default 1.5.

fillSlope.description: Fill batter H per 1 V (> 0). Default 2.0.

laneWidth.description: Carriageway width each side (> 0). Default 3.5 m.

shoulderWidth.description: Shoulder width each side (>= 0). Default 1.0 m.

name: set_road_section

description: Create a named crop box (document units and frame) on some clouds (default: all). keep "inside" shows only the points inside and can be used as a query region ({kind:"crop",cropId}); "outside" hides them. Remove it with clear_scan_crop.

cloudIds.description: Clouds it applies to; default every cloud.

name: set_scan_crop

description: Give a sheet-metal part its material and, optionally, its layer. The folded solid of a part is derived and read-only, so assign_material is refused on it; this command stores the material on the part itself, so mass_properties, the bill of materials and the export gate see it, and it survives every later edit of the part and save / load. The material must exist (create_material, define_material_record or an imported library record: use its name). Converted parts (convert_to_sheet_metal) describe an ordinary solid: use assign_material on it. Refusals: FTR_PART_NOT_FOUND, FTR_PARAM_INVALID. Next: mass_properties, check_sheet_metal.

id.description: Sheet-metal part id (returned by add_sheet_metal_base).

layerId.description: Optional id of an existing layer to put the folded solid on. Omit to leave the layer as it is.

materialName.description: Name of an existing material in the document (case-sensitive), e.g. "al2024".

name: set_sheet_metal_material

description: Calibrate the local site coordinates to the projected grid with a 2D similarity (Helmert): grid = gridOrigin + scaleFactor * R(rotationDeg) * (local - localOrigin), R counter-clockwise. Coordinates are in document units; elevations are unchanged. Used by transform_coordinates, import_survey_points (coordinates "grid") and the LandXML / DXF / sheet exports.

gridOrigin.description: [easting, northing] of the same control point in grid coordinates.

localOrigin.description: [x, y] of a control point in local (document) coordinates.

rotationDeg.description: Counter-clockwise rotation of local axes into grid axes, degrees. Default 0.

scaleFactor.description: Combined scale factor k = grid distance / local distance, > 0. Default 1.

name: set_site_calibration

description: Toggle the suppressed flag of a feature history step by its stepId. A suppressed step is skipped during replay, effectively hiding its contribution without deleting it. The document is regenerated after the flag is changed.

stepId.description: Id of the FeatureStep to suppress or un-suppress (from doc.featureHistory[*].id).

suppressed.description: true to suppress (skip during replay), false to restore.

name: set_step_suppressed

description: Set the superelevation (banking) of an alignment: `maxRate` is the full rate on circular curves as a ratio (0.07 = 7 %, at most 0.15; 0 removes the design). The section rotates about the centreline with the outer side raised: normal crown on tangents, the adverse side runs out to flat then up to the full rate at a constant rotation rate, reaching it at the SC / CS of a spiral (or 30 % of the runoff inside a curve without spiral). `runoffLength` (document units, > 0) is the ramp length from flat to full rate at each curve end; default the spiral length, or the length that keeps the lane-edge relative gradient at 0.5 % (maxRate x laneWidth / 0.005). A rate below the crossfall is raised to the crossfall. Corridor, cross sections, volumes and alignment_report follow.

maxRate.description: Full superelevation rate on curves, ratio 0..0.15 (0.07 = 7 %). 0 removes it.

runoffLength.description: Runoff length per curve end, document units (> 0). Default: spiral length or 0.5 % gradient.

name: set_superelevation

description: Set the temperature field a thermo_static analysis is loaded with (replaces the previous one). source.kind: uniform (one value for all nodes), expression (a function of node coordinates x, y, z evaluated at every mesh node at deck time), thermal_result (nodal temperatures of a SOLVED heat_steady / heat_transient analysis at an output time or "last", on the same mesh or, with mapping "interpolate", on a different mesh by shape-function interpolation; a re-solved or edited thermal analysis makes this analysis stale) or table (x, y, z, T rows in the artifact store, written by the fea_import_field tool). Optional cteBasis states, per material id, whether its cte property model is secant (about a reference temperature) or instantaneous; without it a cte model of unstated basis is refused at solve time (a thermalStrain model needs none). Give source, cteBasis or both. A coupled_temperature_displacement analysis solves its own field: it takes cteBasis only (no source). Next: check_thermo_mechanical.

analysisId.description: Id of a thermo_static (or, for cteBasis only, a coupled_temperature_displacement) analysis.

kind.description: The cte values are secant coefficients about a reference temperature.

referenceTemperature.description: Reference temperature the secant coefficients are relative to.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

kind.description: The cte values are instantaneous (tangent) coefficients.

cteBasis.description: Per material id: the stated basis of its cte property model. Entries replace earlier entries of the same material.

kind.description: The same temperature at every node.

value.description: Temperature { value, unit } with unit degC, K or degF. There is no default.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

coordinatesUnit.description: Unit x, y, z are expressed in when the expression is evaluated.

expression.description: Arithmetic expression of x, y, z (+ - * /, pi, sqrt, hypot, pow, sin, exp, ...; no ^). Example: "20 + 0.5 * z".

kind.description: Temperature computed at each mesh node from an expression in x, y, z.

analysisId.description: Id of the solved heat_* analysis that provides the temperatures.

kind.description: Nodal temperatures of a solved heat_steady / heat_transient analysis (same mesh, or mapping interpolate).

mapping.description: same_mesh (default): the thermal case must be meshed identically (TMC_MESH_MISMATCH otherwise). interpolate: the thermal nodal temperatures are interpolated with the shape functions of the containing thermal element at every node of this analysis mesh (a node outside every thermal element takes the value at the nearest point of the nearest element and is counted).

time.description: Output time in seconds (an output time of the thermal results) or "last".

coordinatesUnit.description: Unit of the x, y, z columns, e.g. "mm".

csvSha256.description: sha256 of the table artifact in the artifact store (written by fea_import_field).

kind.description: Temperatures from a table of x, y, z, T rows stored in the artifact store, matched to mesh nodes.

rows.description: Number of rows of the table (checked against the artifact).

temperatureUnit.description: Unit of the T column: degC, K or degF.

source.description: Where the nodal temperatures come from; omit to leave the field unchanged (cteBasis only).

name: set_temperature_field

description: Override the Stefan-Boltzmann constant of a heat_* analysis (W/(m^2*K^4)) with a sourced value, e.g. to reproduce a published benchmark that rounds sigma (5.67e-8). Without stefanBoltzmann the override is removed and the exact SI value 5.670374419e-8 applies. The override is recorded with defaulted: false and its source in thermal_report.physicalConstants and enters the input hash.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

stefanBoltzmann.description: The override. Omit to restore the SI exact default.

source.description: Citation of the value (a benchmark statement, a standard, a company rule); required.

value.description: Stefan-Boltzmann constant in W/(m^2*K^4), finite and > 0.

name: set_thermal_physical_constants

description: Set the time stepping of a heat_transient analysis (a heat_steady case needs none): endTimeS, initialIncrementS, minIncrementS, maxIncrementS, fixedIncrements (constant increments), maxTemperatureChangePerIncrement (DELTMX, K) and the result times (outputTimesS or outputEveryS; with fixedIncrements only outputEveryS, a multiple of the increment). Times are in seconds. Only the given fields change. A transient also needs set_initial_temperature and cp + density on the materials.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

endTimeS.description: Transient only: end time of the step, seconds, > 0 (required once for a transient).

fixedIncrements.description: true: constant increments (*HEAT TRANSFER, DIRECT). Excludes outputTimesS and maxTemperatureChangePerIncrement.

initialIncrementS.description: First (or, with fixedIncrements, every) time increment, seconds. Default endTimeS/100 (named in the deck).

maxTemperatureChangePerIncrement.description: Largest temperature change per increment as { value, unit: "K" } (DELTMX); the solver shortens increments to respect it.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

outputEveryS.description: Result interval in seconds (default: every increment). Excludes outputTimesS.

outputTimesS.description: Result times in seconds, strictly increasing within (0, endTimeS]. Excludes outputEveryS.

name: set_thermal_step

description: Set (or remove) the thread of a hole feature made by add_hole: a designation such as "MJ6x1-4H5H" or ".1900-32 UNJF-3B", checked against a light per-family grammar. By default it is a cosmetic attribute for drawings, hole_table and code export; the geometry and the shape recipe key are NOT changed. With thread.modelled true the part is rebuilt with a real helical groove (basic 60 degree internal profile, explicit pitch required, bore near the minor diameter; needs a geometry kernel). featureIndex counts the hole/pocket features of the part in the order they were cut (0 = first add_hole or add_pocket on the original solid); hole ids in hole_table read hole-<featureIndex>.<position>. Refusal codes: FTR_PART_NOT_FOUND, FTR_THREAD_DESIGNATION_INVALID, FTR_HOLE_DIAMETERS_INCONSISTENT, FTR_NEEDS_EXACT_KERNEL, FTR_FEATURE_BUILD_FAILED.

featureIndex.description: Index of the hole feature among the part features (add_hole / add_pocket steps in cutting order, from 0).

id.description: Id of the mesh entity made by add_hole.

thread.description: The thread to set, or null to remove it. designation is checked against its family grammar; depth is in document length units.

depth.description: Threaded depth, in document length units. Omit for the full hole depth.

designation.description: Thread designation, e.g. "MJ6x1-4H5H", ".1900-32 UNJF-3B", "M6x1-6H", "1/4-20 UNC-2B". Cosmetic unless modelled is true.

family.description: Thread family (UNJ, MJ, UN, M, other). Omit to infer it from the designation.

modelled.description: true cuts a real helical thread groove (basic 60 degree internal ISO 68-1 profile; M / MJ / UN / UNJ designations with an explicit pitch, e.g. "M6x1"; MJ / UNJ root radius not applied, unverified) into the hole: the bore diameter must be about the minor diameter (D - 1.0825 P) and below the major diameter; needs a geometry kernel; changes the geometry and the shape recipe key. Omit or false = cosmetic, no geometry.

name: set_thread

description: Set the regions of a topology study that must stay solid (keepIn: interfaces, bolt bosses, loaded faces) or must stay empty (keepOut: clearances, routing). Each list you give REPLACES the existing one; omit a list to keep it. A region is a box (world coordinates), another solid (entity) or the voxel layers next to a face / edge / point of a part (target, depthVoxels). Refused when a region does not touch the design domain (TOP_REGION_OUTSIDE_DOMAIN), when keep-in and keep-out overlap, or when the keep-in volume alone reaches the volume budget (TOP_KEEPIN_EXCEEDS_BUDGET: raise volumeFraction or shrink the keep-in regions). Load and support layers are protected automatically (settings.protectLoadSupport), you do not add them here. A recorded result becomes stale.

keepIn.description: Regions that stay solid (replaces the existing keepIn list; [] clears it).

kind.description: All voxels whose centre lies in an axis-aligned box.

max.description: Box maximum corner [x, y, z], world coordinates in document units.

min.description: Box minimum corner [x, y, z], world coordinates in document units.

entityId.description: Id of an existing 3D solid.

kind.description: All voxels whose centre lies inside another solid (an interface boss, a bolt boss, a keep-out volume).

depthVoxels.description: Layers of voxels next to the target, at least 1. Default 1.

kind.description: The layers of voxels next to a face / edge / point of a part (a bearing seat, a loaded face).

target.description: Same targets as add_fea_constraint: points that identify faces / edges / points of a design-domain entity.

edgesNear.description: Points identifying edges: each resolves to the nearest edge.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended edge.

entityId.description: Id of the analysed 3D entity (it must be a part of the analysis: set_part_idealization).

facesNear.description: Points identifying faces: each resolves to the NEAREST face of the entity at meshing time.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended face.

pointsNear.description: Points identifying vertices / locations: each resolves to the nearest vertex or node.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended vertex or location.

keepOut.description: Regions that stay empty (replaces the existing keepOut list; [] clears it).

kind.description: All voxels whose centre lies in an axis-aligned box.

max.description: Box maximum corner [x, y, z], world coordinates in document units.

min.description: Box minimum corner [x, y, z], world coordinates in document units.

entityId.description: Id of an existing 3D solid.

kind.description: All voxels whose centre lies inside another solid (an interface boss, a bolt boss, a keep-out volume).

depthVoxels.description: Layers of voxels next to the target, at least 1. Default 1.

kind.description: The layers of voxels next to a face / edge / point of a part (a bearing seat, a loaded face).

target.description: Same targets as add_fea_constraint: points that identify faces / edges / points of a design-domain entity.

edgesNear.description: Points identifying edges: each resolves to the nearest edge.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended edge.

entityId.description: Id of the analysed 3D entity (it must be a part of the analysis: set_part_idealization).

facesNear.description: Points identifying faces: each resolves to the NEAREST face of the entity at meshing time.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended face.

pointsNear.description: Points identifying vertices / locations: each resolves to the nearest vertex or node.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended vertex or location.

studyId.description: Id of the topology study (affected[0] of create_topology_study, e.g. ts-3.1).

name: set_topology_regions

description: Change the optimizer settings of a topology study; only the values you give change, each is stored as chosen (not a default). Ranges: penal [1, 5], eminRatio (0, 1), move (0, 1], changeTol > 0, maxIterations 1..10000, filter radius > 0 in document length units, threshold and greyLimit (0, 1). filter.kind sensitivity is the classic top88 filter (default); density gives smoother boundaries. protectLoadSupport false reproduces the Andreassen top88 benchmark. manufacturing.symmetry mirrors the derived geometry. A recorded result becomes stale when a solver setting (anything but greyLimit) changes.

changeTol.description: Stop when the largest design change of an iteration is at most this, > 0. Default 0.01.

eminRatio.description: Void stiffness as a fraction of the solid stiffness, in (0, 1). Default 1e-9.

radius.description: Filter radius in document length units, > 0. Default 1.5 voxels. Below 1 voxel the filter does nothing.

greyLimit.description: Mean grey level (4 x (1 - x)) above which check_topology warns, in (0, 1). Default 0.1.

manufacturing.description: Manufacturing constraints (symmetry only in this version).

symmetry.description: Planes through the domain centre across which the density field is mirrored in the derived geometry.

move.description: OC move limit per iteration, in (0, 1]. Default 0.2.

optimizer.description: oc (optimality criteria, built). mma is planned and refused.

penal.description: SIMP penalisation power p, in [1, 5]. Default 3.

protectLoadSupport.description: Keep the voxel layer at every load and support solid. Default true; false reproduces top88.

studyId.description: Id of the topology study (affected[0] of create_topology_study, e.g. ts-3.1).

threshold.description: Density at or above which a voxel counts as solid in the derived geometry, in (0, 1). Default 0.5.

name: set_topology_settings

description: Change an image underlay's display: `opacity` in [0, 1] and/or `locked` (a locked underlay is never picked in the viewport, so tracing over it cannot select it by accident).

id.description: Id of the image underlay.

locked.description: Lock (true) or unlock (false). Omit to keep.

opacity.description: Opacity in [0, 1] (0 = invisible, 1 = opaque). Omit to keep the current value.

name: set_underlay

description: Set the document unit of length and/or the display precision (decimal places). Affects how all geometry values are displayed and labelled. At least one of units or displayPrecision should be provided.

displayPrecision.description: Number of decimal places to show when formatting length values (e.g. 2 → "12.50 mm"). Must be an integer in [0, 20].

units.description: Unit of length for the document. Allowed values: 'mm' (millimetres), 'cm' (centimetres), 'm' (metres), 'in' (inches), 'ft' (feet).

name: set_units

description: Give walls a build-up (wall type), like Revit / ArchiCAD composite walls: layers listed from the right-hand face (looking from start to end — the exterior of a counter-clockwise perimeter) to the left-hand face, each { material, thickness, function: structure | insulation | membrane | air | finish }. Wall thickness becomes the sum; quantities are reported per layer material; plans show the layer lines; IFC gets a material layer set. layers: null removes the build-up.

thickness.description: Layer thickness in document units (> 0).

wallIds.description: Ids of existing straight walls (e.g. ["wall-1"]); curved walls are not accepted.

name: set_wall_layers

description: Compute sheet-metal bend quantities for one bend with no part needed: bend allowance BA = theta*(R+K*T), outside setback OSSB = tan(theta/2)*(R+T), inside setback, bend deduction BD = 2*OSSB-BA (flat length = sum of mold-line legs - BD) and the AC 43.13-1B K-chart value tan(theta/2). All lengths are in `units` ('mm' or 'in', required). The angle is the angle bent THROUGH in degrees (a closed 45-degree angle is a 135-degree bend). Mode k_factor needs kFactor (never defaulted; refusal FTR_K_FACTOR_MISSING); mode faa_empirical uses BA = (0.01743*R+0.0078*T)*theta_deg. Other refusals: FTR_K_FACTOR_OUT_OF_RANGE, FTR_BEND_ANGLE_OUT_OF_RANGE (0 < angle < 180), FTR_PARAM_INVALID. Give material and temper to also return the minimum inside radius of a matching imported radius-table row (import_bend_radius_table). The result carries provenance (formulas, inputs, sources), unverified flags and reviewRequired. Next: create_sheet_metal_rule, then add_sheet_metal_base.

angle.description: Bend angle in degrees: the angle bent THROUGH (0 = flat, 90 = right angle, closed 45-degree angle = 135). Must satisfy 0 < angle < 180.

kFactor.description: K-factor (dimensionless, neutral-axis offset / T). Required in mode k_factor and never defaulted. ANSI 0 < K <= 0.5; DIN 0 < K <= 1 (DIN K = 2 x ANSI K).

kStandard.description: Convention of kFactor (dimensionless K): 'ansi' (default, reported as defaulted) or 'din' (converted to ANSI by halving).

material.description: Material label (e.g. 2024) used with temper to look up the minimum radius row; text, no unit.

mode.description: 'k_factor' (default) uses BA = theta*(R+K*T); 'faa_empirical' uses the FAA/EAA formula BA = (0.01743*R+0.0078*T)*theta_deg and ignores kFactor.

temper.description: Temper label (e.g. T3) used with material to look up the minimum radius row; text, no unit.

thickness.description: Sheet thickness T in `units`; must be > 0.

units.description: Unit of thickness, insideRadius and of every returned length: 'mm' or 'in'. Required.

name: sheet_metal_calc

description: Hollow out a closed 3D solid, leaving walls of the given thickness (grown inward), and replace it with a new mesh entity. The source entity is consumed. By default the result has a sealed internal cavity; pass openFacesNear (points on the faces to remove) for an open-topped shell. Requires a geometry kernel that supports shellSolid; a kernel without it (or a solid that is too thin for the thickness) makes this a graceful no-op that leaves the document unchanged. Target must be a 3D solid (box, cylinder, sphere, cone, torus, wedge, pyramid, extrusion, revolution or mesh).

id.description: Id of the closed 3D solid entity to hollow. Must exist and be a 3D solid.

openFacesNear.description: Faces to leave OPEN (removed), picked by location: each point removes the face nearest to it, giving an open-topped box / pocket instead of a sealed internal cavity. Omit or pass [] for a sealed cavity. Needs the OCC kernel.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] on or near the face to remove (e.g. its centre from inspect_topology).

thickness.description: Wall thickness in document units. Must be > 0 and smaller than half the solid's thinnest dimension.

name: shell_solid

description: Run the rigid-body physics of the mechanism (bodies, joints, gears, motors, propellers) forward in time with a real physics engine (MuJoCo) and report what happens: final speed of every joint (rpm), when it settled, engine torque and power, propeller thrust / torque / absorbed power, and measured gear ratios (a self-check). Gravity applies (set_gravity). Read-only. detail "summary" (default) = numbers only; "series" adds per-sample time series (speeds, positions, torques, thrust, power) for plotting; `energy: true` adds the kinetic / potential / total / dissipated energy balance (J; automatic when a joint or add_spring has a spring) with the work put in by motors / governors / gas pressure (inputWorkJ), the work absorbed by propellers and balanceErrorJ (initial + input - dissipated - propellers - final, ~0), and data.springs (length range and force per add_spring); "poses" also adds every body's pose per sample (for playback). Warnings flag a run that has not settled. Typical: duration 10 s, timestep 0.001 s (use 0.0002 s for fast, light parts). Closed loops (slider-crank, four-bar): before integrating, the start pose is checked and a loop open by more than 1 µm is refused (FPR_LOOP_OPEN, nothing is run or snapped); with loops the default timestep is the "auto" rule min(1 ms, 0.5 deg of crank at the top speed) unless set_dynamics_solver or `timestep` says otherwise, and data.loops reports the largest constraint violation (metres), its tier (pass <= 1 µm, warn <= 10 µm = FPR_LOOP_DRIFT warn, reactions approximate; fail above, reactions unreliable) and the solver settings used. `reactions`: "off", "peaks" (default when the mechanism has loops) or "series": data.reactions gives, per tree joint, the force (N) and moment (N·m) on the child body at the joint anchor in world axes, and per loop closure the resultant force (N) on the child (no moment), each with peak magnitude, time and crank angle (the crank angle axis is the cycle angle of the first cylinder, or the joint named by `crankAxis`); along the axis of a driven joint the reported component includes the drive force itself. With cylinder pressures (add_cylinder_pressure) the sampling defaults to one sample per crank degree and data.engineReport gives, over the last full cycle: torque against crank angle per cylinder and total (detail series), mean torque (N·m), indicated power (kW), IMEP and peak pressure per cylinder, cycle-energy closure (gate 0.5 %, FPR_ENERGY_CLOSURE), speed ripple against the analytic ΔE/(I·ω²), and the peak wrist-pin, rod, side-thrust, crank-pin and main-bearing forces. Simulate at least one full cycle (two crank turns for a four-stroke) after the speed has settled. Next: read data.loops.tier first, then data.engineReport and data.reactions.

crankAxis.description: Id of the revolute tree joint whose angle (deg, 0-360) labels the peaks of reactions; default none (time only).

energy.description: Add the energy balance: data.energy (kinetic, potential = gravity + joint springs relative to the start pose, total, energy dissipated by joint damping / friction, largest departure of the total from its initial value as a fraction of the peak energy) and, with detail "series", data.series.energy per sample. Also inputWorkJ (work of motors, speed governors and cylinder gas pressure), propellerWorkJ (absorbed by propellers) and balanceErrorJ = initial total + input - dissipated - propellers - final total (zero when every energy flow is counted). Default false, except true when a joint or an add_spring has a spring. A lossless mechanism keeps its total constant (conservation check); damping makes it decay by data.energy.dissipatedJ.

reactions.description: Joint / loop reaction forces: "off", "peaks" (default when the mechanism has loops), "series" (adds every sample).

sampleRate.description: Recorded samples per second. Default 50, raised for loop mechanisms to 36 per turn of the crank so periodic motion is not aliased; engines: one per crank degree. At most 6001 samples per run.

timestep.description: Integration step in seconds. Default 0.001 (loops or cylinders: the "auto" rule or the stored solver setting).

name: simulate_motion

description: Automatic pipe sizing: sets each pipe diameter to the smallest commercial size that carries its accumulated design flow at its current slope within `maxDepthRatio` (and `minVelocity` when given). Flows follow the modified rational method of check_drainage_network (entry times, travel times, optional `idf` curve, diverging manholes split by capacity share); sizing and velocities are iterated to convergence (max 10 passes). Only diameters change: inverts stay, so a larger outgoing pipe may end up with its crown above the incoming one - these manholes are reported as WARNING / data.crownWarnings (fix with update_pipe invertFrom for soffit matching). Pipes that fail even at the largest size, or have no downhill slope, are reported and left unchanged.

idf.description: Intensity-duration-frequency curve i = a / (t + b)^c (mm/h, t = time of concentration in minutes) replacing the constant intensity: each pipe uses i at its own Tc (modified rational method). Do not combine with `rainfallIntensityMmH`.

a.description: IDF coefficient a (> 0): i = a / (t + b)^c in mm/h.

maxDepthRatio.description: Maximum flow depth / diameter, 0 to 1. Default 0.8.

minVelocity.description: Minimum velocity in m/s. Default: not enforced.

rainfallIntensityMmH.description: Constant design rainfall intensity in mm/h (> 0). Default 50. Do not combine with `idf`.

name: size_drainage_pipes

description: Read-only: cut a slab |(p - origin) . normal| <= thickness / 2 through a cloud and return its points in plane coordinates (u, v; document units, at most maxPoints <= 20000) with the plane axes, and fitted primitives: fit "circle" finds the pipe sections (RANSAC + algebraic + geometric fit; centre, radius, rms, radiusStd), fit "lines" the straight edges (walls, steel). region bounds the points read (a crop around the section is faster on big clouds). Use it to find the header at rack level before extract_pipes, or to draw sections.

cloudId.description: Id of an attached cloud (affected[0] of attach_point_cloud, e.g. "cloud-1.1").

fit.description: Primitives to fit in the slab (default none).

maxRadius.description: Largest circle radius in document units (default 2 m).

minRadius.description: Smallest circle radius in document units (default 5 mm).

noiseSigma.description: Scanner noise sigma in document units (inlier band 3 sigma; default 2.5 x the section spacing).

normal.description: [x, y, z] plane normal (any length > 0).

origin.description: [x, y, z] point on the cutting plane (document units).

seed.description: RANSAC seed (default 1); same seed = same result (AF-13).

thickness.description: Slab thickness in document units, e.g. 20 (mm).

name: slice_cloud

description: Run the constraint solver and update entity positions so that all declared constraints are satisfied. The solver works on the 2D XY plane (position Z is unchanged): point constraints (coincident, distance, tangent) move entity positions; angle, parallel and perpendicular turn line b about its midpoint (line a is the reference). It iterates up to 64 steps, stopping early when the total constraint residual is below 1e-8. Returns convergence info in data: { residual: number, iterations: number, converged: boolean }. Non-convergent results are returned with the best-effort positions and converged:false. No parameters required.
name: solve_constraints

description: Translate movingId so that its bounding-box minimum face along axis exactly meets the bounding-box maximum face of baseId. Default axis is "z" (+Z up, W5A convention). Use this to stack objects on top of each other without overlapping.

axis.description: Axis along which to stack: "x", "y", or "z" (default "z", +Z up).

baseId.description: Id of the entity acting as the base (not moved).

movingId.description: Id of the entity to move.

name: stack_on

description: Read-only air properties of the U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 (identical to ICAO ISA up to 32 km) at one altitude: temperature, pressure, density, speed of sound, dynamic and kinematic viscosity (Sutherland), local gravity and ratios to sea level. `altitude` in `altitudeUnit` (m default, ft or km); `altitudeType` geometric (default, height above sea level) or geopotential; range -5 km to 86 km geometric. `temperatureOffsetK` gives an ISA+ΔT day (temperature shifted, pressure kept, density from the gas law). Give `speed` (+ `speedUnit`) to also get Mach, dynamic pressure q = ½ρV², equivalent airspeed and Reynolds number per metre or for `referenceLengthM` (chord, body length). Used by analyze_wing, aero_drag, road_load_power and nozzle_performance (ambient pressure).

altitude.description: Altitude in altitudeUnit; -5000 m .. 86000 m geometric.

altitudeType.description: geometric (default): height above mean sea level; geopotential: H = r0 Z / (r0 + Z), r0 6 356 766 m.

altitudeUnit.description: Unit of altitude: m (default), ft or km.

referenceLengthM.description: Reference length in m for the Reynolds number (chord, body length). Default 1 (per metre).

speed.description: Speed (air speed for aircraft, ground speed for road vehicles) in speedUnit, >= 0.

speedUnit.description: Unit of speed: m/s (default), km/h, kn (knot, 1852 m/h) or mph.

temperatureOffsetK.description: ISA deviation ΔT in K (e.g. +15 for a hot day). Default 0.

name: standard_atmosphere

description: Remove one or more animations from the document. If animationId is provided, only that animation is removed (no-op if not found). If targetId is provided (and animationId is not), all animations whose targetId matches are removed. If neither is provided, ALL animations in the document are cleared. affected is always [] because animations are not entities.

animationId.description: Id of a specific animation to remove (e.g. "anim-abc123-4"). Takes precedence over targetId when both are given.

targetId.description: Entity or group id whose animations should all be removed. All animations with this targetId are deleted in one call. Ignored when animationId is also provided.

name: stop_animation

description: Mode-I stress intensity factor K = beta sigma sqrt(pi a) for a crack (crackId from define_crack, OR an inline `geometry`) under a remote tensile `stress` { value, unit }. Centre crack: beta = sqrt(sec(pi a / W)) (a = half-length, W = width, valid a/W <= 0.4); edge crack: Tada or polynomial; surface crack: Newman-Raju at phiDeg (indicative, FRC_K_SOLUTION_UNCONFIRMED). Returns data { KMPaSqrtM, beta, validity { inRange, limits, accuracy, source }, items[], reviewRequired }. Example: centre crack a 10 mm, W 100 mm, 100 MPa gives K = 18.1749 MPa sqrt(m).

crackId.description: Id of a defined crack. Exclusive with `geometry`.

W.description: W: FULL plate width: a length { value > 0, unit } e.g. { value: 10, unit: "mm" }.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

a.description: a: HALF-length of the crack: a length { value > 0, unit } e.g. { value: 10, unit: "mm" }.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

kind.description: Centre through-thickness crack in a finite-width plate (K = sigma sqrt(pi a) sqrt(sec(pi a / W)), valid a/W <= 0.4).

t.description: t: thickness: a length { value > 0, unit } e.g. { value: 10, unit: "mm" }.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

a.description: a: crack depth from the edge: a length { value > 0, unit } e.g. { value: 10, unit: "mm" }.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

b.description: b: plate width: a length { value > 0, unit } e.g. { value: 10, unit: "mm" }.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

description: Closed 2D loops that outline the optimized layout of a solved topology study, ready for the rebuild: model the outer loop with extrude_profile (profile = its points, depth = thickness, position / rotation from `placement`), each hole loop with extrude_profile + boolean subtract, round sharp re-entrant corners with fillet_edge, analyse the rebuilt part (05), then compare_to_topology. A 2D study uses its own plane; for a 3D study give `plane` (XY | XZ | YZ) and `offset`, the coordinate of the section along the plane normal (default the middle of the grid). Loops are in document units; `tolerance` (default one voxel) is the largest deviation of the simplification, `minLoopArea` (default 4 voxel^2, document units^2) drops specks (counted in droppedLoops). widthSamples lists member widths on the medial axis of the section: { at: plane-local [x, y], width (document units), widthMm }, widest first, from an exact distance transform. The loops are a suggestion from a concept result, to be reviewed.

minLoopArea.description: Loops with a smaller area are dropped, document units squared, >= 0. Default 4 voxel^2.

offset.description: 3D only: coordinate of the section plane along its normal, document units. Default the middle of the grid.

plane.description: Section plane of a 3D study (default XY). A 2D study uses its own plane.

studyId.description: Id of the topology study (affected[0] of create_topology_study, e.g. ts-3.1).

tolerance.description: Largest deviation of the simplified loops from the field contour, document units, > 0. Default one voxel.

name: suggest_rebuild

description: Spot elevations and slopes of a terrain surface at plan points. data.points lists { at, elevation (document units, null outside the TIN), slopePercent }.

points.description: Plan points to sample.

items.description: Plan point [x, y].

name: surface_elevation

description: Create a freeform shell part from boundary curves — hoods, fairings, fenders, panels, saddle tops, aero covers. Give 4 curves that close a loop (any order or direction; ends must meet) for a Coons patch spanning them, or 2 opposite curves for a surface ruled between them. Curves are `curves` (each 2+ world points; 3+ points pass a smooth curve through them) or `curveIds` (2D sketch curves — line, arc, polyline, spline — each in its own plane). The surface is thickened by `thickness` behind its front side (flip: in front) into a closed solid with a sharp rim, stored as a subdivision solid: reshape it with edit_subdivision_cage; with the OCC kernel it is an exact B-spline solid (STEP). The smooth surface follows the curves within the smoothing of a `cells` grid (more cells = closer). Returns data { vertexCount, faceCount, vertices }.

cells.description: Cage cells [along the first curve, across] (1..24 each; default [8, 8]).

color.description: Hex color string #rrggbb, e.g. "#c8553d". Defaults to "#6b8f9c".

curveIds.description: 2 or 4 ids of 2D sketch curves bounding the patch (alternative to curves).

curves.description: 2 or 4 boundary curves as world point lists (alternative to curveIds).

items.description: Curve point [x, y, z] in world coordinates.

flip.description: Thicken toward the other side of the surface (default false).

id.description: Optional explicit entity id. If omitted a unique id is generated.

layerId.description: Layer id to assign the entity to. Defaults to the document default layer.

levels.description: Subdivision levels 0..4 (0 = the faceted cage itself; 2-3 is smooth; each level quadruples the face count).

name.description: Optional display name for the entity (shown in the scene tree).

thickness.description: Wall thickness in document units (> 0).

name: surface_from_curves

description: Statistics of a terrain surface: point and triangle counts, plan area (m²), minimum / maximum / mean elevation (m) and mean slope (%).
name: surface_report

description: Sweep a closed cross-section along a 3D path into a solid: pipes, tubes, hoses, handrails, ducts, cable runs, coils. Right-handed world frame, +Z up. Path: either `path`, world [x, y, z] points — joined by straight runs whose corners are rounded with circular bends of bendRadius (pipe elbows), or with smooth: true a smooth spline through the points — or `pathId`, a 2D sketch curve (line, arc, polyline, spline, circle, ellipse, rectangle) placed by its work plane. Paths may be open or closed loops (closed: true, or a closed sketch); a loop has no end caps. Section (exactly one): `radius` for a round tube (+ innerRadius for a hollow pipe), `section` as [x, y] polygon points, or `sectionId` of a closed 2D sketch (circle, ellipse, rectangle, closed polyline/spline). The section is centred on the path; its +y axis points toward world +Z (toward +Y when the path starts vertical) and it is carried along with a rotation-minimizing (twist-free) frame. Paths, bends and sketched sections stay exact for the exact kernel and STEP export. Booleans with other solids work like any primitive (e.g. boolean op union to weld pipes to a flange).

bendRadius.description: Centre-line radius of the bend at each corner of a straight-run path, in document units. Default: 3 × the section radius (a long-radius elbow). Must exceed the section radius.

closed.description: With path points: also join the last point back to the first, making a closed loop (rings, chains, tyre treads, gaskets); the closing corner is bent or smoothed like the others. A closed sketch pathId (circle, ellipse, closed spline/polyline, rectangle) is a loop already.

color.description: Hex color string #rrggbb, e.g. "#c8553d". Defaults to "#6b8f9c".

id.description: Optional explicit entity id. If omitted a unique id is generated.

innerRadius.description: Round section only: bore radius for a hollow pipe (0 < innerRadius < radius).

layerId.description: Layer id to assign the entity to. Defaults to the document default layer.

path.description: World-space [x, y, z] points the section follows (>= 2). Without smooth, consecutive points are joined by straight runs and every corner gets a circular bend of bendRadius.

pathId.description: Id of a 2D sketch curve (line, arc, polyline, spline, circle, ellipse, rectangle; open or closed) to use as the path instead of path.

radius.description: Round section: outer radius (> 0). Use this for pipes, rods, tubes and wires.

section.description: Polygon section: closed [x, y] points in section coordinates (centred on the path; +y toward world +Z). Alternative to radius / sectionId.

sectionId.description: Id of a closed 2D sketch (circle, ellipse, rectangle, closed polyline or spline) used as the section; its local coordinates (relative to its own position) become section coordinates; curves stay exact.

smooth.description: With path points (or a polyline pathId): true = smooth spline through the points (centripetal Catmull-Rom), false (default) = straight runs with circular bends.

stations.description: Variable section: >= 2 cross-sections along the path, with `at` strictly increasing from 0 to 1, each a radius, radiusX+radiusY ellipse, section polygon or sectionId. The section blends smoothly between stations (taper, flatten, round-to-oval, any shape to any shape). Replaces radius / innerRadius / section / sectionId.

at.description: Path fraction of this section: 0 = path start, 1 = path end.

radiusX.description: Elliptical section: half-width along section x (> 0); give with radiusY.

radiusY.description: Elliptical section: half-height along section y (> 0); give with radiusX.

sectionId.description: Id of a closed 2D sketch (circle, ellipse, rectangle, closed polyline/spline).

name: sweep_profile

description: Evaluate a textbook closed-form heat-transfer solution, used as the reference a thermal model must reproduce. Pure and read-only. check: plane_wall (flux q in W/m^2, surface temperatures, heat-balance residual), slab_generation (centre temperature), semi_infinite (erf profile after a surface step), lumped (any body via V and As, or sphere d; returns validity { Bi, ok } with Bi < 0.1), fin (efficiency; with Tb and Tinf also heat rate Q adiabatic / convective-tip / corrected-length and tip temperature), parallel_plates (grey infinite plates, W/m^2), view_factor (needs configuration), stefan (Neumann one-phase melting: root lambda, front position, Stefan number), stefan_boltzmann (sigma from the exact SI constants, no inputs), interface (two slabs with a contact conductance). inputs maps each input name (names marked ? are optional) to { value, unit }; dimensionless inputs use unit "1". Inputs per check: plane_wall: L (wall thickness; length), k (thermal conductivity; conductivity), h1 (film coefficient on face 1; film), Tinf1 (fluid temperature on face 1; temperature), h2 (film coefficient on face 2; film), Tinf2 (fluid temperature on face 2; temperature) · slab_generation: half_thickness (half thickness of the slab; length), k (thermal conductivity; conductivity), qgen (volumetric heat generation (positive = source); generation), Ts (face temperature; temperature) · semi_infinite: Ti (initial uniform temperature; temperature), Ts (surface temperature applied at t = 0; temperature), alpha (thermal diffusivity k/(rho cp); diffusivity), x (depth below the surface; length), t (time since the step; time) · lumped: V? (body volume (with As: any shape); volume), As? (convecting surface area (with V); area), d? (sphere diameter (shorthand for V and As of a sphere; give V and As or d); length), rho (density; density), c (specific heat; specificHeat), k (thermal conductivity; conductivity), h (film coefficient; film), Ti (initial temperature; temperature), Tinf (fluid temperature; temperature), t (time; time) · fin: h (film coefficient; film), k (thermal conductivity; conductivity), d? (pin diameter (gives P = pi d, A = pi d^2/4; or give P and A); length), P? (section perimeter (with A, for any uniform section); length), A? (section cross-sectional area (with P); area), L (fin length; length), Tb? (base temperature (with Tinf: adds heat rates and tip temperatures); temperature), Tinf? (fluid temperature (with Tb); temperature) · parallel_plates: T1 (temperature of plate 1 (degC or K; converted to absolute); temperature), T2 (temperature of plate 2; temperature), eps1 (emissivity of plate 1, 0 < eps <= 1 (unit "1"); ratio), eps2 (emissivity of plate 2, 0 < eps <= 1 (unit "1"); ratio) · view_factor / parallel_rectangles: a (rectangle side a; length), b (rectangle side b; length), c (spacing between the identical, directly opposed rectangles; length) · view_factor / perpendicular_rectangles: l (length of the common edge; length), w (width of surface 1 (normal to the common edge); length), h (height of surface 2 (normal to the common edge); length) · view_factor / coaxial_discs: r1 (radius of disc 1; length), r2 (radius of disc 2; length), L (distance between the coaxial parallel discs; length) · view_factor / cube_summation: a (cube side; length) · stefan: k (conductivity of the liquid; conductivity), rho (density; density), cp (specific heat of the liquid; specificHeat), latent (latent heat of fusion; latentHeat), dT (wall temperature minus melting temperature (unit K); temperatureDifference), t (time since the wall was raised; time) · stefan_boltzmann: no inputs · interface: L1 (thickness of slab 1; length), k1 (conductivity of slab 1; conductivity), hc (interface (gap) conductance; film), L2 (thickness of slab 2; length), k2 (conductivity of slab 2; conductivity), T_hot (outer face temperature of slab 1; temperature), T_cold (outer face temperature of slab 2; temperature). Returns data { value, unit, outputs{name:{value,unit}}, formula, inputs, validity?, physicalConstants? }; temperature results use the unit of the first temperature input; radiation checks report sigma and absolute zero as named defaults. unitSystem (N-m-kg-s, N-mm-t-s, lbf-in-slinch-s) adds data.deckValue: the primary result expressed for a CalculiX deck in that system. Refuses a wrong dimension (THM_UNITS_MISMATCH), emissivity outside (0, 1] (THM_EMISSIVITY_INVALID), film coefficient <= 0 (THM_FILM_INVALID) or other non-physical inputs (THM_INPUT_INVALID). Next: compare a solved model against value with compare_to_expected.

configuration.description: Required when check is view_factor: parallel_rectangles (a, b, c), perpendicular_rectangles (l, w, h), coaxial_discs (r1, r2, L) or cube_summation (a).

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 'W/(m*K)', 'mm', 'degC', '1'.

inputs.description: Input name -> { value, unit }. Names per check are listed in the tool description.

unitSystem.description: Optional FEA unit system: adds data.deckValue, the primary result converted to it (not for temperatures).

name: thermal_analytic_check

description: Report the distortion of a solved analysis (typically thermo_static): for each face, the flatness (max - min signed distance of its nodes to their least-squares plane) before and after the displacement and the change, optionally against a flatness tolerance; for each named point, the displacement of the nearest node. A face is a mesh node set (targetKey of an existing constraint / load / probe target) or the nodes of a solid lying on a plane (onPlane). Lengths are in document units. Reads the stored results artifact; refused when the results are stale or missing. reviewRequired is always true: it is an engineering number for a qualified reviewer, not a drawing verdict.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

name.description: Name of the face in the report, e.g. "mounting face".

onPlane.description: Alternative to targetKey: the nodes of an entity lying on a plane.

distance.description: Select nodes whose distance to the plane is <= this value, in document units (> 0, e.g. 1e-3).

description: Read the thermal results of a heat_steady / heat_transient analysis: data { state: unmeshed | meshed | solved | stale | missing | untrusted, temperatureScale, maxT / minT {value, at (document units), entityId, timeS}, maxHeatFlux {value, unit W/m^2, at, timeS}, bcHeatFlows [{ bcId, timeS, valueW }] (W, positive INTO the part), heatBalance {inW, outW, storedW, residualRel, timeS, tolerance}, probes [{ probeId, series [[timeS, T]] }], heatFluxProbes [{ probeId, name, unit W/m^2, nodeId, nodeDistance, values [{ time, value }] }] (heat_flux probes, value = flux magnitude at the nearest node), physicalConstants (radiation cases: Stefan-Boltzmann and absolute zero with source and defaulted), propertyRangeExceeded, unverified, unverifiedReasons }. Numbers are returned only for state "solved" and are recomputed from the artifact store: a stale result must be re-solved (fea_mesh, fea_solve); "missing" (no artifact store or artifact on this machine) and "untrusted" (FEA_SUMMARY_MISMATCH) withhold them. Check heatBalance.residualRel against the tolerance before reporting a result as final (samplingRel = spread between the end-value and interval-mean quadratures of a transient's last output interval; above the tolerance, write results at every increment); end with check_thermal.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

probes.description: Only these probe ids. Default: all temperature and heat_flux probes.

timeS.description: Report the per-BC heat flows at the result time nearest to this (seconds). Default: the last.

description: Closed-form thermo-mechanical hand calculations with units, for sanity checks and benchmarks (no FE). `check` selects the formula and `inputs` is a record of { value, unit } (any unit of the right dimension; temperature DIFFERENCES in K or degC). restrained: E (MPa: Young's modulus); alpha (1/K: secant CTE); dT (K: temperature rise from the stress-free state); nu (1: Poisson's ratio, in (-1, 0.5)) -> uniaxial, biaxial, triaxial stress in MPa. inclusion: E (MPa: Young's modulus); alpha (1/K: CTE of the inclusion minus CTE of the matrix); dT (K: temperature rise of the inclusion); a (mm: inclusion radius); r? (mm: radius of the outside point (>= a); default a (just outside the disc)) -> stresses inside and outside a hot disc in an infinite plate (NAFEMS T1). bimetal: t1 (mm: thickness of layer 1 (low expansion)); t2 (mm: thickness of layer 2 (high expansion)); E1 (MPa: Young's modulus of layer 1); E2 (MPa: Young's modulus of layer 2); alpha1 (1/K: CTE of layer 1); alpha2 (1/K: CTE of layer 2); dT (K: uniform temperature rise); L? (mm: cantilever length for the tip deflection) -> Timoshenko curvature (1/mm) with an equilibrium cross-check. thick_cylinder: E (MPa: Young's modulus); nu (1: Poisson's ratio, in (-1, 0.5)); alpha (1/K: secant CTE); a (mm: bore radius); b (mm: outer radius (> a)); dT (K: bore minus outer-surface temperature; T(r) = dT ln(b/r)/ln(b/a)); r? (mm: one radius in [a, b]; or use points; default both a and b); optional `points` = radii -> radial/hoop/axial stress rows in MPa. gradient_beam: alpha (1/K: secant CTE); dT (K: temperature difference between the two faces); h (mm: beam depth); L (mm: span (simply supported) or length (cantilever)) -> curvature, mid-span bow, cantilever tip; stress 0. shrink_fit: b (mm: solid shaft radius); c (mm: hub outer radius (> b)); E_hub (MPa: hub Young's modulus); nu_hub (1: hub Poisson's ratio); E_shaft (MPa: shaft Young's modulus); nu_shaft (1: shaft Poisson's ratio); interferenceMax (mm: maximum DIAMETRAL interference at the specification temperature); interferenceMin? (mm: minimum diametral interference at the specification temperature); alpha_hub? (1/K: hub secant CTE (with alpha_shaft, temperature, specTemperature)); alpha_shaft? (1/K: shaft secant CTE); temperature? (K: operating temperature (both parts)); specTemperature? (K: temperature the interferences apply at) -> Lame contact pressure and hub bore hoop stress (MPa); the thermal group adds the interference at temperature. cte_secant: referenceTemperature (K: stress-free temperature the secant CTE is referenced to); alpha0? (1/K: linear law: instantaneous CTE at lawTemperature); alpha1? (1/K^2: linear law: d(alpha)/dT); lawTemperature? (K: linear law: temperature alpha0 is given at); rereferenceTo? (K: also report the secant re-referenced to this temperature), plus `points` = temperatures, and either alpha0/alpha1/lawTemperature or `table` = instantaneous [{T, alpha}] rows -> instantaneous and secant CTE, thermal strain and optional re-referencing. Returns the formulas, inputs and assumptions. Compressive stress is negative; a fit across temperatures is fit_at_temperature.

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 'MPa', 'mm', '1/K', 'K', 'degC', '1' (dimensionless).

inputs.description: Named inputs of the check, each { value, unit } (names listed in the command description).

points.description: thick_cylinder: radii (length) to evaluate; cte_secant: temperatures (K, degC, degF).

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 'MPa', 'mm', '1/K', 'K', 'degC', '1' (dimensionless).

table.description: cte_secant: instantaneous CTE table (piecewise linear, strictly increasing T) instead of alpha0 / alpha1.

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 'MPa', 'mm', '1/K', 'K', 'degC', '1' (dimensionless).

description: Change a fatigue case: any field of create_fatigue_case (omitted fields keep their value; `factors` merges like set_fatigue_factors). The merged case is validated like a new one.

analysisId.description: FE analysis whose STRESS results drive the case. After fea_solve, run the fatigue_field transport (llull-compute, every node) so compute_fatigue can rank the hot spots; without it compute_fatigue refuses with FAT_RESULTS_MISSING.

gate.description: Optional hysteresis gate (>= 0) in history units.

residue.description: half_cycles: residue counted as half cycles; repeat: close the history as a repeating block.

compressiveMean.description: Compressive mean-stress rule: no_benefit (default, conservative) or formula.

damageLimit.description: Miner damage limit D (> 0). Default 1 (Palmgren-Miner rule), reported as defaulted.

marginalBand.description: Margin band (>= 0): 0 <= margin < band is MARGINAL. No default.

modifiers.description: REPLACES the Marin modifier list (surface, size, reliability, ...). Each needs value > 0 and a justification.

justification.description: Mandatory reason / source of the factor.

value.description: Factor > 0 multiplying the curve strength (0.8 = 20 % weaker than the test specimen). Never defaulted.

scatter.description: Scatter factor SF on life. There is NO default: without it compute_fatigue refuses with FAT_SCATTER_FACTOR_UNSET.

source.description: Mandatory source of the factor (regulation, company rule, case input).

mapping.description: Histories driving the case. History-only: stress-kind histories whose scaled series are summed (same length). FE: one load_factor history per load case (loadCase; may be omitted when the analysis has one load case), superposed per node. Needs >= 1 entry.

loadCase.description: FE load case name this history drives (FE input; not used by history-only cases).

scale.description: Multiplier on the history values (history-only: stress = scale x value; FE: scale x load-case stress).

material.description: Curve to use: material record + model ids.

cyclicModelId.description: strain_life: id of the cyclic_ramberg_osgood model.

modelId.description: S-N model id (stress_life) or en_coffin_manson model id (strain_life).

recordId.description: Material record id holding the curve.

walker.description: Walker exponent gamma in (0, 1]; gamma 0.5 equals SWT.

meanStress.description: Mean-stress correction: none | goodman (needs Ftu on the record) | gerber (Ftu) | soderberg (Fty) | morrow (sn_basquin sigma_f) | swt | { walker: gamma }. A compressive mean gives no benefit for goodman / gerber / soderberg / morrow unless compressiveMean "formula". Default none.

method.description: stress_life (S-N, Miner) or strain_life (epsilon-N with Neuber on nominal stress histories).

notch.description: Optional notch: the nominal stress is scaled by Kf = 1 + q (Kt - 1) (Neuber on the cyclic curve for strain-life).

feIncludesKt.description: true when the stress already contains the concentration (no extra Kf); false: Kf scales the nominal stress.

q.description: Notch sensitivity q in [0, 1]: Kf = 1 + q (Kt - 1).

blocksPerUnit.description: Blocks of the history per flight or hour (flights / hours only).

unit.description: Unit of the required life; flights / hours need blocksPerUnit.

description: Change a thermal BC: name, value+unit, filmCoefficient, filmTable, sinkTemperature, emissivity, mode, entityId, target, amplitude or source. Only the given fields change; the kind cannot change (delete and add instead). The result is validated like add_thermal_bc (emissivity 0-1, h > 0, source for film / radiation, unit dimensions). amplitude "" removes the amplitude.

amplitude.description: Optional amplitude id or name (define_amplitude): the BC value (sink temperature for film / radiation) is multiplied by f(t).

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

emissivity.description: radiation only: hemispherical emissivity, 0 to 1. Never defaulted: needs `source` (PHY-15 emissivityIr is not built).

entityId.description: heat_generation only: id of the analysed part (solid) that generates heat.

filmCoefficient.description: film only: constant h as { value, unit } in W/(m^2*K); > 0. Never defaulted: needs `source`. Alternative: filmTable.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

filmTable.description: film only: h(T) of the FACE temperature T instead of filmCoefficient (heat_steady cases only, no amplitude): points [[T on the case scale, h in W/(m^2*K)], ...], at least 2, strictly increasing T, h > 0; end values are held outside the rows. Needs `source`.

points.description: Rows [surface temperature on the case temperature scale, h in W/(m^2*K)]: at least 2, strictly increasing temperature, h > 0.

mode.description: heat_generation only: value is W/m^3 ("density", default) or total power W spread over the part volume ("total").

sinkTemperature.description: film / radiation: temperature of the environment as { value, unit } (degC | K | degF). Radiation uses absolute temperature.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

source.description: REQUIRED for film (h) and radiation (emissivity); optional elsewhere.

citation.description: Where the value comes from: datasheet, correlation, company rule, owner statement.

locator.description: Page, table or clause inside the citation.

target.description: temperature: faces / edges / points; surface_flux, film, radiation: facesNear (document units); concentrated_flux: pointsNear. Not for heat_generation.

edgesNear.description: Points identifying edges: each resolves to the nearest edge.

value.description: temperature / surface_flux / heat_generation / concentrated_flux: the value, in `unit`. temperature in degC | K | degF; surface_flux in W/m^2 (positive INTO the part); heat_generation in W/m^3 (mode density) or W (mode total); concentrated_flux in W.
